variables.voucherScriptContent:
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Retrieves FDO vouchers from Small Form Factor Azure Local nodes. Supports
    one-shot and automated polling modes.

.DESCRIPTION
    This script connects to nested Hyper-V VMs via PuTTY (plink/pscp) over SSH, waits for the FDO PEM
    voucher file to be generated, and downloads it to a local directory.

    In polling mode (-Wait), the script periodically checks each node until
    either all vouchers have been retrieved or the timeout is reached. This
    allows it to be launched immediately after the VMs boot from the installer
    ISO — it will keep retrying until the nodes finish provisioning and produce
    the voucher files.

    SSH key-based authentication is required for unattended / polling operation.
    Generate a key pair and distribute the public key to the nodes, or pass
    -SshKeyPath to point at an existing private key.

.PARAMETER RemoteHosts
    Array of IP addresses for the remote edge nodes. When omitted, the script
    auto-discovers active VM IPs from the local DHCP server scope.

.PARAMETER BasePath
    Local base directory where vouchers will be stored. Default is "c:\vouchers".
    Subdirectories will be created for each remote host.

.PARAMETER SshUser
    SSH username for connecting to remote hosts. Default is "edgeuser".

.PARAMETER SshKeyPath
    Path to a PuTTY/OpenSSH private key file for key-based authentication. When
    provided, the script uses -i with plink/pscp and disables password prompts,
    enabling fully unattended operation.

.PARAMETER SshPassword
    SSH password for password-based authentication with plink/pscp. If both
    -SshKeyPath and -SshPassword are supplied, key-based auth takes precedence.

.PARAMETER DhcpScopeId
    DHCP scope ID used for auto-discovery when RemoteHosts is not specified.
    Default is "192.168.100.0" (the NAT subnet configured by setup.ps1).

.PARAMETER NestedVmPrefix
    VM name prefix used to identify nested VMs on the local Hyper-V host when
    auto-discovering RemoteHosts via VM MAC-to-DHCP lease matching.

.PARAMETER Wait
    Enable polling mode. The script will periodically check each node for the
    voucher file until all are retrieved or -TimeoutMinutes is reached.

.PARAMETER CollectHostKeys
    Helper mode that probes each target host and prints ready-to-copy
    host=fingerprint entries for use with -HostKeyFingerprint.

.PARAMETER AutoTrustHostKeys
    When set, automatically performs TOFU (trust on first use): retrieves each
    host fingerprint using plink in batch mode, then uses -hostkey for all
    subsequent SSH/SCP operations in this run.

.PARAMETER PollIntervalSeconds
    Seconds between polling attempts in -Wait mode. Default is 60.

.PARAMETER TimeoutMinutes
    Maximum time to wait in -Wait mode before giving up. Default is 120 (2 hours).

.EXAMPLE
    .\Get-SffNodeVoucher.ps1 -Wait -SshKeyPath C:\Users\azureadmin\.ssh\id_rsa

    Description:
    Auto-discovers VM IPs from DHCP, polls every 60 seconds until all vouchers
    are retrieved (or 2-hour timeout), using SSH key auth.

.EXAMPLE
    .\Get-SffNodeVoucher.ps1 -Wait -PollIntervalSeconds 30 -TimeoutMinutes 60

    Description:
    Polls every 30 seconds with a 1-hour timeout, prompting for SSH passwords.

.EXAMPLE
    .\Get-SffNodeVoucher.ps1 -RemoteHosts @("192.168.100.100", "192.168.100.101")

    Description:
    One-shot retrieval from specific hosts (prompts for SSH password).

.NOTES
    - For unattended polling, set up SSH key-based auth and pass -SshKeyPath
    - Requires PuTTY tools: plink.exe and pscp.exe
    - Voucher files are expected in /mnt/data/var-overlay/upper/staging/export/vouchers
    - The script skips nodes that already have a voucher downloaded locally
    - Logs are written to <BasePath>\voucher-retrieval.log when -Wait is used

.INPUTS
    None. You cannot pipe objects to this script.

.OUTPUTS
    None. The script creates local directories and downloads files.
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$false)]
    [string[]]$RemoteHosts,

    [Parameter(Mandatory=$false)]
    [string]$BasePath = "c:\vouchers",

    [Parameter(Mandatory=$false)]
    [string]$SshUser = "edgeuser",

    [Parameter(Mandatory=$false)]
    [string]$SshKeyPath,

    [Parameter(Mandatory=$false)]
    [string]$SshPassword = "Password1",

    [Parameter(Mandatory=$false)]
    [string]$DhcpScopeId = "192.168.100.0",

    [Parameter(Mandatory=$false)]
    [string]$NestedVmPrefix = "NestedVM",

    [Parameter(Mandatory=$false)]
    [string[]]$HostKeyFingerprint,

    [switch]$Wait,

    [switch]$CollectHostKeys,

    [switch]$AutoTrustHostKeys,

    [Parameter(Mandatory=$false)]
    [int]$PollIntervalSeconds = 60,

    [Parameter(Mandatory=$false)]
    [int]$TimeoutMinutes = 120
)

# Validate PowerShell console environment
if ($host.Name -ne "ConsoleHost") {
    Write-Warning "This script must be run in the standard PowerShell console"
    exit
}

$ScriptVersion = "1.3.5"
$LogFile = "$BasePath\voucher-retrieval.log"
$script:DiscoveredHostKeys = @{}

# Ensure BasePath exists before any Write-Status may append to the log (e.g. when -Wait is used)
if (-not (Test-Path $BasePath)) {
    New-Item -Path $BasePath -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
}

function Write-Status {
    param([string]$Message, [string]$Color = "White")
    $ts = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"
    $line = "$ts - [Get-SffNodeVoucher.ps1 v$ScriptVersion] $Message"
    Write-Host $line -ForegroundColor $Color
    if ($Wait) {
        $line | Out-File -Append -FilePath $LogFile -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }
}

function Get-HostKeyForHost {
    param([string]$HostIP)

    if ($script:DiscoveredHostKeys.ContainsKey($HostIP)) {
        return $script:DiscoveredHostKeys[$HostIP]
    }

    if (-not $HostKeyFingerprint -or $HostKeyFingerprint.Count -eq 0) {
        return $null
    }

    if ($HostKeyFingerprint.Count -eq 1 -and $HostKeyFingerprint[0] -notmatch "=") {
        return $HostKeyFingerprint[0]
    }

    foreach ($entry in $HostKeyFingerprint) {
        if ($entry -match "^\s*([^=]+)\s*=\s*(.+)\s*$") {
            $hostPart = $Matches[1].Trim()
            $keyPart = $Matches[2].Trim()
            if ($hostPart -ieq $HostIP) {
                return $keyPart
            }
        }
    }

    return $null
}

function Get-PuttyArgs {
    param([string]$HostIP)

    $puttyArgs = @("-ssh", "-l", $SshUser)
    # Use batch mode for unattended flows. AutoTrustHostKeys discovers host keys
    # up front, so it is also safe to run non-interactively.
    if ($Wait -or $SshKeyPath -or $AutoTrustHostKeys) {
        $puttyArgs += @("-batch")
    }

    $resolvedHostKey = Get-HostKeyForHost -HostIP $HostIP
    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($resolvedHostKey)) {
        $puttyArgs += @("-hostkey", $resolvedHostKey)
    }

    if ($SshKeyPath) {
        $puttyArgs += @("-i", $SshKeyPath)
    } elseif (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($SshPassword)) {
        $puttyArgs += @("-pw", $SshPassword)
    }
    return $puttyArgs
}

function Resolve-PuttyToolPath {
    param([string]$ToolName)

    $cmd = Get-Command $ToolName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($cmd -and $cmd.Path) {
        return $cmd.Path
    }

    $fallback = "C:\Program Files\PuTTY\$ToolName"
    if (Test-Path $fallback) {
        return $fallback
    }

    return $null
}

function Normalize-MacAddress {
    param([string]$Mac)
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Mac)) {
        return ""
    }
    return (($Mac -replace "[-:\.]", "").ToUpperInvariant())
}

function Test-VoucherExists {
    param([string]$HostIP)
    $targetPath = "$BasePath\$HostIP"
    if (Test-Path $targetPath) {
        $existing = Get-ChildItem -Path $targetPath -Filter "*.pem" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        if ($existing) { return $true }
    }
    return $false
}

function Get-VoucherFromNode {
    param([string]$HostIP)

    $targetPath = "$BasePath\$HostIP"
    if (-not (Test-Path $targetPath)) {
        New-Item -Path $targetPath -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
    }

    $pemFilesCommand = "find /mnt/data/var-overlay/upper/staging/export/vouchers -type f -name '*.pem' 2>/dev/null"
    $puttyCommonArgs = Get-PuttyArgs -HostIP $HostIP

    try {
        $sshResult = Invoke-ProcessCapture -FilePath $script:PlinkPath -Arguments (@($puttyCommonArgs) + @($HostIP, $pemFilesCommand))
        if ($sshResult.ExitCode -ne 0) {
            $errText = ($sshResult.StdErr -split "(`r`n|`n)" | Where-Object { -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($_) } | Select-Object -First 1)
            if (-not $errText) { $errText = "SSH command failed (exit $($sshResult.ExitCode))" }
            Write-Status "Error connecting to ${HostIP}: $errText" "Red"
            return "ssh_failed"
        }

        $pemFile = ($sshResult.StdOut -split "(`r`n|`n)" | Where-Object { -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($_) } | Select-Object -First 1)
        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($pemFile)) {
            return "not_ready"
        }

        Write-Status "Copying voucher from ${HostIP}:${pemFile} to $targetPath" "Green"
        $scpResult = Invoke-ProcessCapture -FilePath $script:PscpPath -Arguments (@($puttyCommonArgs) + @("${HostIP}:${pemFile}", $targetPath))

        if ($scpResult.ExitCode -eq 0) {
            $pemName = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($pemFile)
            $ipScopedPemPath = Join-Path $targetPath $pemName
            $rootPemPath = Join-Path $BasePath $pemName
            if (Test-Path $ipScopedPemPath) {
                Copy-Item -Path $ipScopedPemPath -Destination $rootPemPath -Force
                Write-Status "Copied voucher to root path: $rootPemPath" "DarkGray"
            }
            Write-Status "Successfully retrieved voucher from $HostIP" "Green"
            return "success"
        } else {
            $errText = ($scpResult.StdErr -split "(`r`n|`n)" | Where-Object { -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($_) } | Select-Object -First 1)
            if ($errText) {
                Write-Status "SCP error for ${HostIP}: $errText" "Yellow"
            }
            return "scp_failed"
        }
    }
    catch {
        Write-Status "Unexpected error connecting to ${HostIP}: $($_.Exception.Message)" "Red"
        return "error"
    }
}

function Invoke-ProcessCapture {
    param(
        [string]$FilePath,
        [string[]]$Arguments
    )

    $psi = New-Object System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo
    $psi.FileName = $FilePath
    $psi.UseShellExecute = $false
    $psi.RedirectStandardOutput = $true
    $psi.RedirectStandardError = $true
    if ($Arguments) {
        $psi.Arguments = [string]::Join(" ", ($Arguments | ForEach-Object {
            if ($_ -match '\s') { '"' + $_.Replace('"', '\"') + '"' } else { $_ }
        }))
    }

    $proc = New-Object System.Diagnostics.Process
    $proc.StartInfo = $psi
    $null = $proc.Start()
    $stdout = $proc.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd()
    $stderr = $proc.StandardError.ReadToEnd()
    $proc.WaitForExit()

    return @{
        ExitCode = $proc.ExitCode
        StdOut   = $stdout
        StdErr   = $stderr
    }
}

function Get-HostFingerprintFromPlink {
    param([string]$HostIP)

    $scanArgs = @("-batch", "-ssh", "-l", $SshUser, $HostIP, "exit")
    $result = Invoke-ProcessCapture -FilePath $script:PlinkPath -Arguments $scanArgs
    $scanOutput = "$($result.StdOut)`n$($result.StdErr)"

    $lines = $scanOutput -split "(`r`n|`n)"
    foreach ($line in $lines) {
        if ($line -match "(ssh-[a-z0-9-]+\s+\d+\s+SHA256:[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+)") {
            return $Matches[1]
        }
    }

    return $null
}

function Initialize-TrustedHostKeys {
    if (-not $AutoTrustHostKeys) {
        return
    }

    Write-Status "Auto-trust mode enabled. Discovering SSH host fingerprints..." "Cyan"
    foreach ($hostIp in $RemoteHosts) {
        if ($script:DiscoveredHostKeys.ContainsKey($hostIp)) {
            continue
        }

        $fp = Get-HostFingerprintFromPlink -HostIP $hostIp
        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($fp)) {
            Write-Status "Could not auto-discover host key for $hostIp. SSH may still prompt/fail for this host." "Yellow"
            continue
        }

        $script:DiscoveredHostKeys[$hostIp] = $fp
        Write-Status "Discovered host key for ${hostIp}: $fp" "DarkGray"
    }
}

$script:PlinkPath = Resolve-PuttyToolPath -ToolName "plink.exe"
$script:PscpPath  = Resolve-PuttyToolPath -ToolName "pscp.exe"
if (-not $script:PlinkPath -or -not $script:PscpPath) {
    Write-Status "PuTTY tools not found. Ensure plink.exe and pscp.exe are installed and available in PATH." "Red"
    exit 1
}

Write-Status "Script started. Version: $ScriptVersion" "Cyan"
if ($Wait -and (-not $HostKeyFingerprint -or $HostKeyFingerprint.Count -eq 0)) {
    Write-Status "WARNING: Polling mode is non-interactive; provide -HostKeyFingerprint or pre-cache host keys for plink/pscp." "Yellow"
}

# --- Auto-discover VM IPs from DHCP if not provided ---
if (-not $RemoteHosts) {
    Write-Status "No RemoteHosts specified - resolving VM IPs from Hyper-V MAC addresses via DHCP scope $DhcpScopeId ..." "Yellow"
    try {
        $targetVms = Get-VM -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.Name -like "$NestedVmPrefix-*" }
        if (-not $targetVms) {
            Write-Status "No VMs found with prefix '$NestedVmPrefix-' on this host." "Red"
            exit 1
        }

        $vmMacToName = @{}
        foreach ($vm in $targetVms) {
            $adapter = Get-VMNetworkAdapter -VMName $vm.Name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1
            if (-not $adapter) {
                continue
            }

            $normalizedMac = Normalize-MacAddress $adapter.MacAddress
            if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($normalizedMac)) {
                $vmMacToName[$normalizedMac] = $vm.Name
            }
        }

        if ($vmMacToName.Count -eq 0) {
            Write-Status "Could not read MAC addresses from any VMs matching '$NestedVmPrefix-*'." "Red"
            exit 1
        }

        $leases = Get-DhcpServerV4Lease -ScopeId $DhcpScopeId -ErrorAction Stop |
                  Where-Object { $_.AddressState -like "*Active*" -and -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($_.ClientId) }
        if (-not $leases) {
            Write-Status "No active DHCP leases found in scope $DhcpScopeId. Are the VMs running?" "Red"
            exit 1
        }

        $resolvedHosts = @()
        foreach ($lease in $leases) {
            $leaseMac = Normalize-MacAddress $lease.ClientId
            if ($vmMacToName.ContainsKey($leaseMac)) {
                $resolvedHosts += $lease.IPAddress.IPAddressToString
            }
        }

        $RemoteHosts = $resolvedHosts | Sort-Object -Unique
        if (-not $RemoteHosts) {
            Write-Status "No DHCP leases matched VM MAC addresses for '$NestedVmPrefix-*' in scope $DhcpScopeId." "Red"
            exit 1
        }

        Write-Status "Discovered $($RemoteHosts.Count) VM(s) by MAC-to-DHCP match: $($RemoteHosts -join ', ')" "Green"
    }
    catch {
        Write-Status "Failed VM MAC/DHCP discovery: $($_.Exception.Message). Pass -RemoteHosts explicitly." "Red"
        exit 1
    }
}

if (-not (Test-Path $BasePath)) {
    New-Item -Path $BasePath -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
}

Initialize-TrustedHostKeys

# --- Host-key helper mode ---
if ($CollectHostKeys) {
    Write-Status "=== Host key helper mode ===" "Cyan"
    Write-Status "Collecting fingerprints for $($RemoteHosts.Count) host(s) ..." "Cyan"
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "Use the following values with -HostKeyFingerprint:" -ForegroundColor Green

    $found = 0
    foreach ($remoteHost in $RemoteHosts) {
        $fp = Get-HostFingerprintFromPlink -HostIP $remoteHost
        if ($fp) {
            Write-Host ("`"{0}={1}`"" -f $remoteHost, $fp) -ForegroundColor Green
            $found++
        } else {
            Write-Status "Could not extract host fingerprint from $remoteHost. Ensure SSH is reachable and try again." "Yellow"
        }
    }

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Status "Collected $found of $($RemoteHosts.Count) host fingerprints." "Cyan"
    exit
}

# --- One-shot mode ---
if (-not $Wait) {
    foreach ($remoteHost in $RemoteHosts) {
        Write-Status "Processing $remoteHost ..." "Cyan"
        if (Test-VoucherExists $remoteHost) {
            Write-Status "Voucher already downloaded for $remoteHost - skipping" "Yellow"
            continue
        }
        $result = Get-VoucherFromNode $remoteHost
        switch ($result) {
            "not_ready"  { Write-Status "No voucher file found yet on $remoteHost" "Yellow" }
            "ssh_failed" { Write-Status "SSH connection failed to $remoteHost" "Red" }
            "scp_failed" { Write-Status "SCP transfer failed from $remoteHost" "Red" }
            "error"      { }  # already logged
            "success"    { }  # already logged
        }
    }
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "*** VOUCHER RETRIEVAL COMPLETE ***" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "Vouchers directory: $BasePath" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    exit
}

# --- Polling mode ---
Write-Status "=== Polling mode enabled ===" "Cyan"
Write-Status "Poll interval: ${PollIntervalSeconds}s | Timeout: ${TimeoutMinutes}m | Nodes: $($RemoteHosts.Count)" "Cyan"
if ($SshKeyPath) {
    Write-Status "SSH key: $SshKeyPath" "Cyan"
} elseif (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($SshPassword)) {
    Write-Status "Using SSH password authentication for user '$SshUser'." "Cyan"
} else {
    Write-Status "WARNING: No -SshKeyPath or -SshPassword specified. SSH may prompt for passwords on each attempt." "Yellow"
}

$pendingHosts = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new($RemoteHosts)
$deadline = (Get-Date).AddMinutes($TimeoutMinutes)
$attempt = 0

while ($pendingHosts.Count -gt 0 -and (Get-Date) -lt $deadline) {
    $attempt++
    $remaining = [math]::Round(($deadline - (Get-Date)).TotalMinutes, 1)
    Write-Status "--- Attempt $attempt | Pending: $($pendingHosts.Count) node(s) | Time remaining: ${remaining}m ---" "Cyan"

    $completed = @()
    foreach ($remoteHost in $pendingHosts) {
        if (Test-VoucherExists $remoteHost) {
            Write-Status "Voucher already exists locally for $remoteHost" "Green"
            $completed += $remoteHost
            continue
        }

        $result = Get-VoucherFromNode $remoteHost
        switch ($result) {
            "success"    { $completed += $remoteHost }
            "not_ready"  { Write-Status "$remoteHost - voucher not yet available, will retry" "Yellow" }
            "ssh_failed" { Write-Status "$remoteHost - node not reachable via SSH yet, will retry" "Yellow" }
            "scp_failed" { Write-Status "$remoteHost - SCP failed, will retry" "Yellow" }
            "error"      { }  # already logged
        }
    }

    foreach ($done in $completed) {
        $pendingHosts.Remove($done) | Out-Null
    }

    if ($pendingHosts.Count -eq 0) {
        break
    }

    Write-Status "Waiting ${PollIntervalSeconds}s before next check ..." "DarkGray"
    Start-Sleep -Seconds $PollIntervalSeconds
}

Write-Host ""
$retrieved = $RemoteHosts.Count - $pendingHosts.Count
if ($pendingHosts.Count -eq 0) {
    Write-Host "*** ALL $retrieved VOUCHER(S) RETRIEVED SUCCESSFULLY ***" -ForegroundColor Green
} else {
    Write-Host "*** TIMEOUT: Retrieved $retrieved of $($RemoteHosts.Count) voucher(s) ***" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host "Still pending: $($pendingHosts -join ', ')" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}
Write-Host "Vouchers directory: $BasePath" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "Log file: $LogFile" -ForegroundColor Cyan
variables.bootstrapScriptContent:
#Requires -Version 5.1
# Runs from Azure Custom Script Extension download folder (with setup / voucher scripts).
# Replaces fragile inline powershell -Command strings in ARM/Bicep.

param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$SetupScriptFileName,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$VoucherScriptFileName,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$BootstrapScriptFileName,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$K3sArcScriptFileName,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$K3sJoinAgentScriptFileName,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$K3sBootstrapAgentsScriptFileName,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$K3sSetupInstructionsFileName,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$OsImagePackageUrl,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$ConfiguratorAppUrl,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$NestedVmPrefix,
    [ValidateSet(1, 3)]
    [int]$NestedVmCount = 3,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$AdminUsername,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$AdminPassword,
    # Comma-separated extra files downloaded by the extension to copy into C:\Scripts
    # (K3s automation: Deploy-K3sCluster.ps1, k3s-node-prep.sh, k3s-install-server.sh).
    [string]$AdditionalScriptFileNames = ''
)

# CSE runs commandToExecute via cmd.exe: single quotes are literal, so args can arrive as 'setup.ps1'.
function Shrink-CseArg([string]$Value) {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Value)) { return $Value }
    $t = $Value.Trim()
    if ($t.Length -ge 2) {
        $a, $b = $t[0], $t[$t.Length - 1]
        if ($a -eq $b -and ($a -eq [char]0x27 -or $a -eq [char]0x22)) {
            return $t.Substring(1, $t.Length - 2)
        }
    }
    return $t
}
$SetupScriptFileName = Shrink-CseArg $SetupScriptFileName
$VoucherScriptFileName = Shrink-CseArg $VoucherScriptFileName
$BootstrapScriptFileName = Shrink-CseArg $BootstrapScriptFileName
$K3sArcScriptFileName = Shrink-CseArg $K3sArcScriptFileName
$K3sJoinAgentScriptFileName = Shrink-CseArg $K3sJoinAgentScriptFileName
$K3sBootstrapAgentsScriptFileName = Shrink-CseArg $K3sBootstrapAgentsScriptFileName
$K3sSetupInstructionsFileName = Shrink-CseArg $K3sSetupInstructionsFileName
$OsImagePackageUrl = Shrink-CseArg $OsImagePackageUrl
$ConfiguratorAppUrl = Shrink-CseArg $ConfiguratorAppUrl
$NestedVmPrefix = Shrink-CseArg $NestedVmPrefix
$AdminUsername = Shrink-CseArg $AdminUsername
$AdminPassword = Shrink-CseArg $AdminPassword
$AdditionalScriptFileNames = Shrink-CseArg $AdditionalScriptFileNames

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

Install-WindowsFeature -Name Hyper-V, DHCP -IncludeManagementTools

New-Item -Path 'C:\Scripts' -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
Copy-Item -Path ".\$SetupScriptFileName" -Destination "C:\Scripts\$SetupScriptFileName" -Force
Copy-Item -Path ".\$VoucherScriptFileName" -Destination "C:\Scripts\$VoucherScriptFileName" -Force
Copy-Item -Path ".\$BootstrapScriptFileName" -Destination "C:\Scripts\$BootstrapScriptFileName" -Force
Copy-Item -Path ".\$K3sArcScriptFileName" -Destination "C:\Scripts\$K3sArcScriptFileName" -Force
Copy-Item -Path ".\$K3sJoinAgentScriptFileName" -Destination "C:\Scripts\$K3sJoinAgentScriptFileName" -Force
Copy-Item -Path ".\$K3sBootstrapAgentsScriptFileName" -Destination "C:\Scripts\$K3sBootstrapAgentsScriptFileName" -Force
Copy-Item -Path ".\$K3sSetupInstructionsFileName" -Destination "C:\Scripts\$K3sSetupInstructionsFileName" -Force

}
New-Item -Path 'C:\Scripts\keys' -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null

New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer' -Name 'HideSCAHealth' -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force
# Use .NET for this key: PowerShell's registry provider + New-Item -Force can throw "Cannot delete a subkey tree..." on some Server images.

New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\OOBE' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\OOBE' -Name 'DisablePrivacyExperience' -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force
New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null

New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection' -Name 'AllowDeviceNameInTelemetry' -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection' -Name 'DoNotShowFeedbackNotifications' -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection' -Name 'AllowTailoredExperiencesWithDiagnosticData' -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force
New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\SQMClient\Windows' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\SQMClient\Windows' -Name 'CEIPEnable' -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force
New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Error Reporting' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Error Reporting' -Name 'Disabled' -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force

$runOnceValue = "powershell.exe -NoExit -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\Scripts\$SetupScriptFileName -OsImagePackageUrl '$OsImagePackageUrl' -ConfiguratorAppUrl '$ConfiguratorAppUrl' -VMPrefix '$NestedVmPrefix' -VMCount $NestedVmCount"
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce' -Name 'RunSetupScript' -Value $runOnceValue

$winlogon = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon'
Set-ItemProperty -Path $winlogon -Name 'AutoAdminLogon' -Value '1'
Set-ItemProperty -Path $winlogon -Name 'DefaultUserName' -Value $AdminUsername
Set-ItemProperty -Path $winlogon -Name 'DefaultPassword' -Value $AdminPassword
Set-ItemProperty -Path $winlogon -Name 'AutoLogonCount' -Value 1 -Type DWord

Restart-Computer -Force
variables.k3sArcScriptContent:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# The K3s installer uses /opt/bin when /usr/local/bin is read-only; sudo may not have either on PATH.
export PATH="$PATH:/usr/local/bin:/opt/bin"

###############################################################################
# K3s Install + Azure Arc Connected Cluster Setup Script
#
# This script:
#   1. Installs K3s on the local device
#   2. Configures kubeconfig for local API server access
#   3. Pulls the Azure CLI container image (no host install required)
#   4. Connects the K3s cluster to Azure Arc (az connectedk8s connect)
#   5. Enables Azure RBAC on the Arc-enabled cluster
#   6. Configures the K3s API server webhooks for Azure RBAC
#
# The Azure CLI runs entirely inside a container using K3s's bundled
# containerd runtime — nothing is installed on the host OS.
#
# Prerequisites:
#   - Linux device with root/sudo access
#   - Internet connectivity
#   - An Azure subscription (you'll be prompted to log in via device code)
#
# Usage:
#   chmod +x setup-k3s-arc.sh
#   sudo ./setup-k3s-arc.sh
#
# Or override defaults with environment variables:
#   RESOURCE_GROUP=myRG CLUSTER_NAME=myCluster LOCATION=eastus sudo -E ./setup-k3s-arc.sh
#
# Non-interactive login (used by Deploy-K3sCluster.ps1): put these in ENV_FILE
# (default /tmp/k3s-lab/arc.env, sourced when present) instead of using a device code:
#   AZURE_CLIENT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET, AZURE_TENANT_ID [, AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID]
# The service principal needs Contributor on the resource group, plus
# User Access Administrator (or Owner) when Azure RBAC is enabled.
#
# Other switches:
#   SKIP_AZURE_RBAC=true    - connect to Arc only (skip steps 5-6)
#   ARC_WEBHOOKS_ONLY=true  - only run step 6; use on additional HA servers after
#                             the first server has been connected and RBAC enabled
###############################################################################

ENV_FILE="${ENV_FILE:-/tmp/k3s-lab/arc.env}"
if [[ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]]; then
  # shellcheck disable=SC1090
  source "$ENV_FILE"
fi

# ── Configurable variables (override via environment) ────────────────────────
RESOURCE_GROUP="${RESOURCE_GROUP:-arc-k3s-rg}"
CLUSTER_NAME="${CLUSTER_NAME:-arc-k3s-cluster}"
LOCATION="${LOCATION:-eastus}"
K3S_VERSION="${K3S_VERSION:-}"            # leave empty for latest stable
ONBOARDING_TIMEOUT="${ONBOARDING_TIMEOUT:-1200}"
AZ_CLI_IMAGE="${AZ_CLI_IMAGE:-mcr.microsoft.com/azure-cli:latest}"
AZ_STATE_DIR="/tmp/az-cli-state"          # persists Azure login state between runs
SKIP_AZURE_RBAC="${SKIP_AZURE_RBAC:-false}"
ARC_WEBHOOKS_ONLY="${ARC_WEBHOOKS_ONLY:-false}"
export KUBECONFIG="/etc/rancher/k3s/k3s.yaml"

# Use the kubectl bundled with K3s: the /usr/local/bin symlink may not exist on
# read-only images (the installer falls back to /opt/bin, which sudo may not have on PATH).
kubectl() { k3s kubectl "$@"; }

# ── Helper functions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log()  { echo -e "\n\033[1;32m[INFO]\033[0m  $*"; }
warn() { echo -e "\n\033[1;33m[WARN]\033[0m  $*"; }
err()  { echo -e "\n\033[1;31m[ERROR]\033[0m $*" >&2; exit 1; }

# Run az CLI commands inside a container via K3s's bundled containerd.
# Mounts kubeconfig and a persistent Azure state dir so login survives
# across invocations.
run_az() {
  local container_id="az-cli-$(date +%s%N)"
  k3s ctr run \
    --rm \
    --net-host \
    --mount "type=bind,src=/etc/rancher/k3s/k3s.yaml,dst=/root/.kube/config,options=rbind:ro" \
    --mount "type=bind,src=${AZ_STATE_DIR},dst=/root/.azure,options=rbind:rw" \
    "${AZ_CLI_IMAGE}" \
    "${container_id}" \
    az "$@"
}

# Interactive variant for commands that need TTY (e.g., device-code login)
run_az_interactive() {
  local container_id="az-cli-$(date +%s%N)"
  k3s ctr run \
    --rm \
    --tty \
    --net-host \
    --mount "type=bind,src=/etc/rancher/k3s/k3s.yaml,dst=/root/.kube/config,options=rbind:ro" \
    --mount "type=bind,src=${AZ_STATE_DIR},dst=/root/.azure,options=rbind:rw" \
    "${AZ_CLI_IMAGE}" \
    "${container_id}" \
    az "$@"
}

# Service principal login. The secret goes to the container through an env file
# (mode 600, removed afterwards) so it never appears in a process command line.
az_login_service_principal() {
  local env_file container_id="az-cli-$(date +%s%N)"
  env_file="$(mktemp)"
  chmod 600 "$env_file"
  printf 'AZURE_CLIENT_ID=%s\nAZURE_CLIENT_SECRET=%s\nAZURE_TENANT_ID=%s\n' \
    "$AZURE_CLIENT_ID" "$AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET" "$AZURE_TENANT_ID" >"$env_file"
  local rc=0
  k3s ctr run \
    --rm \
    --net-host \
    --env-file "$env_file" \
    --mount "type=bind,src=${AZ_STATE_DIR},dst=/root/.azure,options=rbind:rw" \
    "${AZ_CLI_IMAGE}" \
    "${container_id}" \
    bash -c 'az login --service-principal -u "$AZURE_CLIENT_ID" -p "$AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET" --tenant "$AZURE_TENANT_ID" -o none' || rc=$?
  rm -f "$env_file"
  (( rc == 0 )) || err "Service principal login failed (exit $rc)."
}

check_root() {
  if [[ $EUID -ne 0 ]]; then
    err "This script must be run as root (use sudo)."
  fi
}

# ── Step 1: Install K3s ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
install_k3s() {
  log "Step 1/6 — Installing K3s..."

  if command -v k3s &>/dev/null; then
    warn "K3s is already installed ($(k3s --version)). Skipping install."
  else
    local install_env="INSTALL_K3S_SKIP_SELINUX_RPM=true"
    if [[ -n "${K3S_VERSION}" ]]; then
      install_env="$install_env INSTALL_K3S_VERSION=${K3S_VERSION}"
    fi
    curl -sfL https://get.k3s.io | env $install_env sh -s - --disable traefik
    log "K3s installed successfully."
  fi

  # Wait for the K3s node to be Ready
  log "Waiting for K3s node to become Ready..."
  local retries=30
  while (( retries > 0 )); do
    if k3s kubectl get nodes 2>/dev/null | grep -q ' Ready'; then
      log "K3s node is Ready."
      break
    fi
    retries=$((retries - 1))
    sleep 5
  done
  if (( retries == 0 )); then
    err "Timed out waiting for K3s node to become Ready."
  fi
}

# ── Step 2: Configure kubeconfig for local API access ────────────────────────
configure_kubeconfig() {
  log "Step 2/6 — Configuring kubeconfig for local kube API server access..."

  local k3s_kubeconfig="/etc/rancher/k3s/k3s.yaml"
  if [[ ! -f "$k3s_kubeconfig" ]]; then
    err "K3s kubeconfig not found at $k3s_kubeconfig"
  fi

  # Set up kubeconfig so kubectl and az CLI can find it
  export KUBECONFIG="$k3s_kubeconfig"

  # Also make it accessible for non-root usage later
  local user_home="${SUDO_USER:+$(eval echo ~${SUDO_USER})}"
  if [[ -n "$user_home" ]]; then
    mkdir -p "$user_home/.kube"
    cp "$k3s_kubeconfig" "$user_home/.kube/config"
    chown "$(id -u "${SUDO_USER}")":"$(id -g "${SUDO_USER}")" "$user_home/.kube/config"
    chmod 600 "$user_home/.kube/config"
    log "Kubeconfig copied to $user_home/.kube/config"
  fi

  # Verify connectivity
  kubectl get nodes || err "Cannot reach the Kubernetes API server."
  log "Local kube API server access confirmed."
}

# ── Step 3: Pull Azure CLI container image + install extension + login ────────
setup_azure_cli() {
  log "Step 3/6 — Setting up Azure CLI container and connectedk8s extension..."

  # Create persistent state dir for Azure login tokens (root only)
  mkdir -p "$AZ_STATE_DIR"
  chmod 700 "$AZ_STATE_DIR"

  # Pull the Azure CLI image into K3s's containerd
  log "Pulling Azure CLI container image: ${AZ_CLI_IMAGE}..."
  k3s ctr images pull "${AZ_CLI_IMAGE}"

  log "Azure CLI container image ready."
  run_az version --query '"azure-cli"' -o tsv && \
    log "Azure CLI version confirmed." || err "Failed to run az CLI from container."

  # Install the connectedk8s extension inside a persistent state dir
  # The extension is stored in ~/.azure so it persists across runs
  log "Installing connectedk8s extension..."
  run_az extension add --name connectedk8s --yes 2>/dev/null || \
    run_az extension update --name connectedk8s --yes 2>/dev/null || true

  # Log in: service principal when credentials are supplied, otherwise device code
  if ! run_az account show &>/dev/null; then
    if [[ -n "${AZURE_CLIENT_ID:-}" && -n "${AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET:-}" && -n "${AZURE_TENANT_ID:-}" ]]; then
      log "Logging in to Azure with service principal ${AZURE_CLIENT_ID}..."
      az_login_service_principal
    else
      log "Please log in to Azure using a device code..."
      run_az_interactive login --use-device-code
    fi
  else
    log "Already logged in to Azure."
  fi

  if [[ -n "${AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID:-}" ]]; then
    log "Selecting subscription ${AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID}..."
    run_az account set --subscription "$AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID"
  fi

  # Ensure the resource group exists
  if ! run_az group show --name "$RESOURCE_GROUP" &>/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "Creating resource group '$RESOURCE_GROUP' in '$LOCATION'..."
    run_az group create --name "$RESOURCE_GROUP" --location "$LOCATION" -o none
  else
    log "Resource group '$RESOURCE_GROUP' already exists."
  fi
}

# ── Step 4: Connect the cluster to Azure Arc ─────────────────────────────────
connect_to_arc() {
  log "Step 4/6 — Connecting K3s cluster to Azure Arc..."

  # Check if already connected
  if run_az connectedk8s show -g "$RESOURCE_GROUP" -n "$CLUSTER_NAME" &>/dev/null 2>&1; then
    warn "Cluster '$CLUSTER_NAME' is already connected to Azure Arc. Skipping."
    return
  fi

  run_az connectedk8s connect \
    --name "$CLUSTER_NAME" \
    --resource-group "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
    --location "$LOCATION" \
    --distribution k3s \
    --infrastructure generic \
    --kube-config /root/.kube/config \
    --onboarding-timeout "$ONBOARDING_TIMEOUT"

  log "Cluster successfully connected to Azure Arc."

  # Verify the connection
  run_az connectedk8s show -g "$RESOURCE_GROUP" -n "$CLUSTER_NAME" -o table
}

# ── Step 5: Enable Azure RBAC on the cluster ─────────────────────────────────
enable_azure_rbac() {
  log "Step 5/6 — Enabling Azure RBAC on the Arc-enabled cluster..."

  # Get the cluster's managed identity principal ID
  local cluster_msi_id
  cluster_msi_id=$(run_az connectedk8s show \
    -g "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
    -n "$CLUSTER_NAME" \
    --query identity.principalId -o tsv)

  if [[ -z "$cluster_msi_id" ]]; then
    err "Could not retrieve the cluster managed identity principal ID."
  fi
  log "Cluster MSI Principal ID: $cluster_msi_id"

  # Get the cluster ARM resource ID
  local cluster_arm_id
  cluster_arm_id=$(run_az connectedk8s show \
    -g "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
    -n "$CLUSTER_NAME" \
    --query id -o tsv)

  # Assign the Connected Cluster Managed Identity CheckAccess Reader role
  log "Assigning 'Connected Cluster Managed Identity CheckAccess Reader' role..."
  run_az role assignment create \
    --role "Connected Cluster Managed Identity CheckAccess Reader" \
    --assignee "$cluster_msi_id" \
    --scope "$cluster_arm_id" \
    -o none 2>/dev/null || warn "Role assignment may already exist."

  # Enable Azure RBAC feature
  log "Enabling azure-rbac feature on the connected cluster..."
  run_az connectedk8s enable-features \
    -n "$CLUSTER_NAME" \
    -g "$RESOURCE_GROUP" \
    --features azure-rbac \
    --kube-config /root/.kube/config

  log "Azure RBAC enabled on the cluster."
}

# ── Step 6: Configure K3s API server for Azure RBAC webhooks ─────────────────
configure_rbac_webhooks() {
  log "Step 6/6 — Configuring K3s API server for Azure RBAC webhooks..."

  # Extract the guard webhook configs from the Kubernetes secret
  # (jsonpath instead of jq: jq is not present on Azure Local SFF nodes)
  mkdir -p /etc/guard
  chmod 700 /etc/guard

  kubectl get secret azure-arc-guard-manifests -n kube-system \
    -o jsonpath='{.data.guard-authn-webhook\.yaml}' | base64 -d > /etc/guard/guard-authn-webhook.yaml
  kubectl get secret azure-arc-guard-manifests -n kube-system \
    -o jsonpath='{.data.guard-authz-webhook\.yaml}' | base64 -d > /etc/guard/guard-authz-webhook.yaml

  local f
  for f in /etc/guard/guard-authn-webhook.yaml /etc/guard/guard-authz-webhook.yaml; do
    [[ -s "$f" ]] || err "Could not extract $f from secret azure-arc-guard-manifests. Is azure-rbac enabled on the connected cluster?"
  done

  log "Guard webhook configs written to /etc/guard/"

  # For K3s, configure the API server via the K3s config file
  local k3s_config="/etc/rancher/k3s/config.yaml"

  # Back up existing config if present
  if [[ -f "$k3s_config" ]]; then
    cp "$k3s_config" "${k3s_config}.bak.$(date +%s)"
    log "Backed up existing K3s config."
  fi

  # Check if kube-apiserver-arg already exists in the config
  if [[ -f "$k3s_config" ]] && grep -q 'kube-apiserver-arg' "$k3s_config"; then
    warn "kube-apiserver-arg entries already exist in $k3s_config."
    warn "Please manually verify the following args are present:"
    cat <<'ARGS'
  - authentication-token-webhook-config-file=/etc/guard/guard-authn-webhook.yaml
  - authentication-token-webhook-cache-ttl=5m0s
  - authentication-token-webhook-version=v1
  - authorization-webhook-config-file=/etc/guard/guard-authz-webhook.yaml
  - authorization-webhook-cache-authorized-ttl=5m0s
  - authorization-webhook-version=v1
  - authorization-mode=Node,RBAC,Webhook
ARGS
  else
    # Append the webhook configuration to the K3s config
    cat >> "$k3s_config" <<'EOF'

# Azure Arc RBAC webhook configuration
kube-apiserver-arg:
  - "authentication-token-webhook-config-file=/etc/guard/guard-authn-webhook.yaml"
  - "authentication-token-webhook-cache-ttl=5m0s"
  - "authentication-token-webhook-version=v1"
  - "authorization-webhook-config-file=/etc/guard/guard-authz-webhook.yaml"
  - "authorization-webhook-cache-authorized-ttl=5m0s"
  - "authorization-webhook-version=v1"
  - "authorization-mode=Node,RBAC,Webhook"
EOF
    log "K3s API server webhook args written to $k3s_config"
  fi

  # Restart K3s to apply the new API server configuration
  log "Restarting K3s to apply webhook configuration..."
  systemctl restart k3s

  # Wait for K3s to come back up
  log "Waiting for K3s to restart..."
  local retries=30
  while (( retries > 0 )); do
    if kubectl get nodes &>/dev/null 2>&1; then
      log "K3s is back up and running."
      break
    fi
    retries=$((retries - 1))
    sleep 5
  done
  if (( retries == 0 )); then
    err "Timed out waiting for K3s to restart after webhook configuration."
  fi
}

# ── Main ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
main() {
  echo "============================================================"
  echo "  K3s + Azure Arc Connected Cluster Setup"
  echo "============================================================"
  echo ""
  echo "  Resource Group : $RESOURCE_GROUP"
  echo "  Cluster Name   : $CLUSTER_NAME"
  echo "  Location       : $LOCATION"
  echo ""

  check_root

  if [[ "$ARC_WEBHOOKS_ONLY" == "true" ]]; then
    systemctl is-active --quiet k3s || err "ARC_WEBHOOKS_ONLY needs a running K3s server on this node."
    configure_rbac_webhooks
    log "Azure RBAC webhooks configured on $(hostname)."
    return
  fi

  install_k3s
  configure_kubeconfig
  setup_azure_cli
  connect_to_arc
  if [[ "$SKIP_AZURE_RBAC" == "true" ]]; then
    warn "SKIP_AZURE_RBAC=true - skipping Azure RBAC (steps 5-6)."
  else
    enable_azure_rbac
    configure_rbac_webhooks
  fi

  echo ""
  log "============================================================"
  log "  Setup complete!"
  log "  Cluster '$CLUSTER_NAME' is connected to Azure Arc."
  log ""
  log "  Verify with:"
  log "    az connectedk8s show -g $RESOURCE_GROUP -n $CLUSTER_NAME -o table"
  log "    kubectl get pods -n azure-arc"
  log "============================================================"
}
