variables.k3sJoinAgentScriptContent:
#!/bin/bash
# Run on each worker node (NestedVM-02 / NestedVM-03) with sudo after the
# management node has a working K3s server.
#
# Requires environment variables (same contract as https://get.k3s.io):
#   K3S_URL   - e.g. https://192.168.100.100:6443 (reachable from this host)
#   K3S_TOKEN - from the server: sudo cat /var/lib/rancher/k3s/server/node-token
#
# Both can instead be placed in ENV_FILE (default /tmp/k3s-lab/k3s.env), which
# is sourced when present; Deploy-K3sCluster.ps1 uses this so the token never
# appears on a command line.
#
# Optional:
#   INSTALL_K3S_VERSION - pin to the same build as the server (recommended)
#   NODE_IP             - IP the agent advertises (default: first 192.168.100.x address)
#   NODE_NAME           - override node name (default: hostname)
#   READY_TIMEOUT       - seconds to wait for k3s-agent to become active (default 180)
#
# Example:
#   export K3S_URL="https://192.168.100.100:6443"
#   export K3S_TOKEN="K10....::server:...."
#   sudo -E ./k3s-join-agent.sh
#
set -euo pipefail

# The K3s installer uses /opt/bin when /usr/local/bin is read-only; sudo may not have either on PATH.
export PATH="$PATH:/usr/local/bin:/opt/bin"

ENV_FILE="${ENV_FILE:-/tmp/k3s-lab/k3s.env}"
if [[ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]]; then
  # shellcheck disable=SC1090
  source "$ENV_FILE"
fi
READY_TIMEOUT="${READY_TIMEOUT:-180}"

log()  { echo -e "\n\033[1;32m[INFO]\033[0m  $*"; }
warn() { echo -e "\n\033[1;33m[WARN]\033[0m  $*"; }
err()  { echo -e "\n\033[1;31m[ERROR]\033[0m $*" >&2; exit 1; }

check_root() {
  if [[ "${EUID:-0}" -ne 0 ]]; then
    err "Run as root (e.g. sudo -E $0) so K3S_TOKEN from the environment is preserved."
  fi
}

detect_node_ip() {
  if [[ -n "${NODE_IP:-}" ]]; then
    return
  fi
  NODE_IP="$(ip -4 addr show 2>/dev/null | grep -oE 'inet 192\.168\.100\.[0-9]+' | awk '{print $2}' | head -n1 || true)"
}

join_k3s_agent() {
  [[ -n "${K3S_URL:-}" ]]  || err "Set K3S_URL (e.g. https://<management-ip>:6443)."
  [[ -n "${K3S_TOKEN:-}" ]] || err "Set K3S_TOKEN from the management node."

  if systemctl is-active --quiet k3s-agent 2>/dev/null; then
    warn "k3s-agent is already active. Nothing to do."
    return 0
  fi

  if systemctl is-active --quiet k3s 2>/dev/null; then
    err "This host is running the k3s server service (k3s). Join agents only on worker nodes."
  fi

  detect_node_ip
  local exec_args="agent"
  [[ -n "${NODE_IP:-}" ]]   && exec_args="$exec_args --node-ip ${NODE_IP}"
  [[ -n "${NODE_NAME:-}" ]] && exec_args="$exec_args --node-name ${NODE_NAME}"

  log "Installing K3s agent (INSTALL_K3S_SKIP_SELINUX_RPM=true, exec: $exec_args)..."
  export INSTALL_K3S_SKIP_SELINUX_RPM=true
  export INSTALL_K3S_EXEC="$exec_args"
  export K3S_URL K3S_TOKEN
  if [[ -n "${INSTALL_K3S_VERSION:-}" ]]; then
    export INSTALL_K3S_VERSION
  else
    unset INSTALL_K3S_VERSION 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  curl -sfL https://get.k3s.io | sh -s -

  log "Waiting up to ${READY_TIMEOUT}s for k3s-agent..."
  local deadline=$((SECONDS + READY_TIMEOUT))
  until systemctl is-active --quiet k3s-agent; do
    (( SECONDS < deadline )) || err "k3s-agent failed to start. Check: journalctl -u k3s-agent -n 200"
    sleep 5
  done
  log "Joined cluster. On the management node run: kubectl get nodes"
}

main() {
  echo "============================================================"
  echo "  K3s agent join (get.k3s.io)"
  echo "============================================================"
  check_root
  join_k3s_agent
}

main "$@"
variables.k3sBootstrapAgentsScriptContent:
#!/bin/bash
# Run on the K3s management / server node (NestedVM-01) with sudo. Installs
# K3s agents on the other two nested VMs over SSH using the same SELinux RPM
# skip as setup-k3s-arc.sh / k3s-join-agent.sh.
#
# Prerequisites:
#   - K3s server already installed and running on this host (setup-k3s-arc.sh).
#   - SSH private key on this host that can authenticate as SSH_USER to each
#     worker (default after Arc provisioning: clouduser).
#   - This script and k3s-join-agent.sh in the same directory (or set JOIN_SCRIPT).
#
# Usage:
#   export K3S_WORKER_IPS="192.168.100.101 192.168.100.102"
#   sudo -E ./bootstrap-k3s-agents.sh
#
# Optional environment:
#   K3S_URL              - override API URL shown to agents (default: https://<this host's 192.168.100.x>:6443)
#   SSH_USER             - default clouduser
#   SSH_IDENTITY         - default $SUDO_HOME/.ssh/id_rsa or /root/.ssh/id_rsa or $HOME/.ssh/id_rsa
#   SSH_OPTS             - extra ssh/scp args, e.g. '-o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new'
#   JOIN_SCRIPT          - path to k3s-join-agent.sh (default: beside this script)
#   INSTALL_K3S_VERSION  - passed to workers to match server (auto-set from `k3s --version` when empty)
#
# --- One-time: copy these scripts from the Hyper-V host (Windows) to the management VM ---
# On the Azure VM (RDP/Bastion), open PowerShell. Install OpenSSH Client if needed
# (Settings -> Apps -> Optional features). Replace <MGMT_IP> with the management nested
# VM address (often 192.168.100.x from DHCP). Use your real repo or script path:
#
#   mkdir $env:USERPROFILE\k3s-stage -Force
#   scp C:\Scripts\bootstrap-k3s-agents.sh clouduser@<MGMT_IP>:~/k3s/
#   scp C:\Scripts\k3s-join-agent.sh clouduser@<MGMT_IP>:~/k3s/
#
# On the management Linux VM:
#   mkdir -p ~/k3s && chmod +x ~/k3s/bootstrap-k3s-agents.sh ~/k3s/k3s-join-agent.sh
#
# --- One-time: SSH private key on the management VM (for NestedVM-02 and NestedVM-03) ---
# bootstrap-k3s-agents.sh connects as SSH_USER (default clouduser) to each worker IP.
# That user needs key-based SSH. Typical lab approach: reuse the same key pair the
# Hyper-V host uses with Get-SffNodeVoucher.ps1 if workers already trust it.
# From the Hyper-V host PowerShell (example paths from README):
#
#   scp C:\Users\azureadmin\.ssh\id_rsa clouduser@<MGMT_IP>:~/.ssh/id_rsa_from_host
#   ssh clouduser@<MGMT_IP> "chmod 600 ~/.ssh/id_rsa_from_host"
#
# Then on the management VM either merge into ~/.ssh/id_rsa or run bootstrap with:
#   export SSH_IDENTITY=$HOME/.ssh/id_rsa_from_host
#
# Alternative: generate a new key on the management node and append the new public key
# to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys on vm2 and vm3 (one-time access from the host with your
# existing key).
#
set -euo pipefail

# The K3s installer uses /opt/bin when /usr/local/bin is read-only; sudo may not have either on PATH.
export PATH="$PATH:/usr/local/bin:/opt/bin"

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
JOIN_SCRIPT="${JOIN_SCRIPT:-$SCRIPT_DIR/k3s-join-agent.sh}"

log()  { echo -e "\n\033[1;32m[INFO]\033[0m  $*"; }
warn() { echo -e "\n\033[1;33m[WARN]\033[0m  $*"; }
err()  { echo -e "\n\033[1;31m[ERROR]\033[0m $*" >&2; exit 1; }

: "${K3S_WORKER_IPS:=}"
[[ -n "$K3S_WORKER_IPS" ]] || err "Set K3S_WORKER_IPS to the two worker IPs (space-separated), e.g. export K3S_WORKER_IPS='192.168.100.101 192.168.100.102'"

SSH_USER="${SSH_USER:-clouduser}"
SSH_OPTS="${SSH_OPTS:-}"

# When invoked via sudo, prefer the user who invoked sudo for key location.
effective_home="${SUDO_HOME:-}"
if [[ -z "$effective_home" && -n "${SUDO_USER:-}" ]]; then
  effective_home=$(getent passwd "$SUDO_USER" | cut -d: -f6 || true)
fi
effective_home="${effective_home:-$HOME}"
SSH_IDENTITY="${SSH_IDENTITY:-}"
if [[ -z "$SSH_IDENTITY" ]]; then
  for cand in "$effective_home/.ssh/id_rsa" "$effective_home/.ssh/id_ed25519" /root/.ssh/id_rsa; do
    if [[ -f "$cand" ]]; then
      SSH_IDENTITY="$cand"
      break
    fi
  done
fi
[[ -f "$SSH_IDENTITY" ]] || err "No SSH private key found. Set SSH_IDENTITY to a key that can reach $SSH_USER@<workers>."

[[ -f "$JOIN_SCRIPT" ]] || err "Join helper not found: $JOIN_SCRIPT (copy k3s-join-agent.sh next to this script or set JOIN_SCRIPT)."

check_root() {
  if [[ "${EUID:-0}" -ne 0 ]]; then
    err "Run as root (sudo -E $0) to read /var/lib/rancher/k3s/server/node-token."
  fi
}

detect_k3s_url() {
  if [[ -n "${K3S_URL:-}" ]]; then
    log "Using K3S_URL from environment: $K3S_URL"
    return
  fi
  local ip
  ip="$(ip -4 addr show 2>/dev/null | grep -oE 'inet 192\.168\.100\.[0-9]+' | awk '{print $2}' | head -n1 || true)"
  if [[ -z "$ip" ]]; then
    ip="$(hostname -I 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' || true)"
  fi
  [[ -n "$ip" ]] || err "Could not determine this host's IP. Set K3S_URL explicitly."
  K3S_URL="https://${ip}:6443"
  log "Using K3S_URL=$K3S_URL (set K3S_URL to override if workers cannot reach this address)."
}

read_join_token() {
  local token_file="/var/lib/rancher/k3s/server/node-token"
  [[ -f "$token_file" ]] || err "Missing $token_file - is K3s server installed on this node?"
  K3S_TOKEN="$(tr -d '\n\r' <"$token_file")"
  [[ -n "$K3S_TOKEN" ]] || err "Empty node token in $token_file"
}

detect_install_version() {
  if [[ -n "${INSTALL_K3S_VERSION:-}" ]]; then
    return
  fi
  # Example line: k3s version v1.30.2+k3s1 (...)
  local ver
  ver="$(k3s --version 2>/dev/null | head -n1 | awk '{print $3}' || true)"
  if [[ -n "$ver" ]]; then
    INSTALL_K3S_VERSION="$ver"
    log "Pinning workers to INSTALL_K3S_VERSION=$INSTALL_K3S_VERSION (unset INSTALL_K3S_VERSION to use channel default)."
  else
    warn "Could not read k3s --version; workers will use install script default channel."
  fi
}

remote_join() {
  local target="$1"
  local q_url q_tok ver_prefix=""
  q_url=$(printf '%q' "$K3S_URL")
  q_tok=$(printf '%q' "$K3S_TOKEN")
  if [[ -n "${INSTALL_K3S_VERSION:-}" ]]; then
    ver_prefix="INSTALL_K3S_VERSION=$(printf '%q' "$INSTALL_K3S_VERSION") "
  fi
  log "Joining $SSH_USER@$target ..."
  # shellcheck disable=SC2086
  scp $SSH_OPTS -i "$SSH_IDENTITY" "$JOIN_SCRIPT" "${SSH_USER}@${target}:/tmp/k3s-join-agent.sh"
  # shellcheck disable=SC2086
  ssh $SSH_OPTS -i "$SSH_IDENTITY" "${SSH_USER}@${target}" \
    "sudo env INSTALL_K3S_SKIP_SELINUX_RPM=true ${ver_prefix}K3S_URL=${q_url} K3S_TOKEN=${q_tok} bash /tmp/k3s-join-agent.sh; rm -f /tmp/k3s-join-agent.sh"
  log "Finished $target"
}

main() {
  echo "============================================================"
  echo "  K3s - bootstrap agents from management node"
  echo "============================================================"

  check_root
  systemctl is-active --quiet k3s || err "k3s server service is not active. Complete setup on this node first."

  detect_k3s_url
  read_join_token
  detect_install_version

  for ip in $K3S_WORKER_IPS; do
    remote_join "$ip"
  done

  log "All workers processed. Verify: kubectl get nodes -o wide"
}

main "$@"
variables.k3sSetupInstructionsContent:
================================================================================
  K3s cluster setup (Azure Local SFF lab)
================================================================================

Scripts on this Hyper-V host (after provisioning): C:\Scripts\

  Deploy-K3sCluster.ps1     - ONE-COMMAND cluster build from this host (recommended)
  k3s-node-prep.sh          - Node prep: kernel modules, sysctl, firewall, egress check
  k3s-install-server.sh     - K3s server install (first server, or HA join)
  k3s-join-agent.sh         - Join one worker (agent) to the cluster
  setup_k3s_arc.sh          - Connect the cluster to Azure Arc (+ Azure RBAC)
  bootstrap-k3s-agents.sh   - Manual alternative: join workers from the server node
  Get-SffNodeVoucher.ps1    - FDO vouchers during initial install (edgeuser; pre-Arc)
  K3S-CLUSTER-SETUP.txt     - This file

Nested VMs: NestedVM-01 (first server), NestedVM-02 and NestedVM-03.
Network: 192.168.100.0/24 (DHCP 192.168.100.100-200).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PREREQUISITES (all nodes - do not skip)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  1. setup.ps1 completed (C:\Scripts\setup.log, C:\Scripts\.setup-completed).
  2. Azure Local provisioning finished on every nested VM and each node is
     registered and Arc-enabled in Azure (portal workflow).
  3. The provisioning SSH private key is on this host in C:\Scripts\keys\

SSH after provisioning (not during ISO / FDO install):

  User:     clouduser
  Auth:     SSH private key generated at provisioning time

That key is downloaded to the Downloads folder of the PC that ran the Azure
portal provisioning session. Copy it to this host:

  - One key for all nodes:   C:\Scripts\keys\<anything>.pem  (only file there)
  - One key per node:        C:\Scripts\keys\NestedVM-01.pem, NestedVM-02.pem, ...

clouduser must have passwordless sudo on every node. Do not use edgeuser for
K3s; it applies to the earlier install/voucher phase only.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AUTOMATED DEPLOYMENT (recommended)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Open PowerShell as Administrator on this host and run:

  C:\Scripts\Deploy-K3sCluster.ps1 -Wait -InstallKubectl

What it does (each step is idempotent - safe to re-run after a failure):

  1. Finds node IPs from Hyper-V MAC addresses + DHCP leases
  2. -Wait: polls until the key is in C:\Scripts\keys and every node accepts
     SSH as clouduser with sudo (start it, then finish provisioning)
  3. Uploads the Linux scripts to /tmp/k3s-lab on each node over SSH
  4. Runs k3s-node-prep.sh on each node
  5. Installs the K3s server on NestedVM-01, then joins NestedVM-02/03
  6. Waits until all nodes are Ready, labels workers
  7. Saves C:\Scripts\k3s\kubeconfig (and kubectl.exe with -InstallKubectl)

Then from this host:

  $env:KUBECONFIG = 'C:\Scripts\k3s\kubeconfig'
  C:\Scripts\k3s\bin\kubectl.exe get nodes -o wide

Useful options:

  -Topology HA            All three nodes are servers (embedded etcd); survives
                          the loss of any one node. Default ServerAgents is
                          1 server (NestedVM-01) + 2 agents.
  -K3sVersion v1.33.5+k3s1  Pin a K3s release (default: stable channel).
  -SshKeyPath <file>      Use a specific key for every node.
  -NodeIPs a,b,c          Skip discovery; first IP becomes the first server.

Logs and state: C:\Scripts\k3s\deploy-k3s.log, C:\Scripts\k3s\cluster.json

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AZURE ARC (optional)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Add -EnableArc to connect the cluster to Azure Arc with Azure RBAC.

Interactive (a device code is shown in the console):

  C:\Scripts\Deploy-K3sCluster.ps1 -EnableArc -ArcResourceGroup rg-arc-k3s `
      -ArcClusterName sff-k3s -ArcLocation uksouth

Unattended (service principal; needs Contributor on the resource group, and
User Access Administrator or Owner when Azure RBAC is enabled):

  $sp = Get-Credential    # user name = appId, password = client secret
  C:\Scripts\Deploy-K3sCluster.ps1 -EnableArc -ArcServicePrincipal $sp `
      -ArcTenantId <tenant-id> -ArcSubscriptionId <subscription-id> `
      -ArcResourceGroup rg-arc-k3s -ArcLocation uksouth

  -SkipAzureRbac connects to Arc without configuring Azure RBAC webhooks.
  With -Topology HA the RBAC webhooks are applied to all three servers.

Secrets (cluster token, client secret) are sent over SSH stdin into mode-600
files under /tmp/k3s-lab and removed afterwards; they are never put on a
command line or written to the log.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MANUAL DEPLOYMENT (alternative)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

From this host (PowerShell; ssh/scp are built into Windows Server 2025):

  $key = 'C:\Scripts\keys\NestedVM-01.pem'
  scp -i $key C:\Scripts\k3s-node-prep.sh C:\Scripts\k3s-install-server.sh `
      C:\Scripts\k3s-join-agent.sh C:\Scripts\setup_k3s_arc.sh clouduser@<MGMT_IP>:~/
  # repeat the scp for each worker IP (k3s-node-prep.sh and k3s-join-agent.sh)

On every node:

  sudo bash ~/k3s-node-prep.sh

On the first server (NestedVM-01):

  sudo env K3S_ROLE=init NODE_IP=<MGMT_IP> bash ~/k3s-install-server.sh
  sudo cat /var/lib/rancher/k3s/server/token

On each worker:

  sudo env K3S_URL=https://<MGMT_IP>:6443 K3S_TOKEN=<token> bash ~/k3s-join-agent.sh

Optionally on the first server (Arc + Azure RBAC, device-code login):

  sudo env RESOURCE_GROUP=arc-k3s-rg CLUSTER_NAME=arc-k3s-cluster LOCATION=eastus \
           bash ~/setup_k3s_arc.sh

Verify on the first server:

  sudo k3s kubectl get nodes -o wide

bootstrap-k3s-agents.sh is still available to join workers from the server
node over SSH (see the comments at the top of that script).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TROUBLESHOOTING
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

- C:\Scripts missing files: re-run terraform apply (or redeploy Bicep) so the
  Custom Script Extension refreshes copies; check C:\WindowsAzure\Logs\Plugins\
  Microsoft.Compute.CustomScriptExtension\. Note: re-running the extension
  reboots this host.

- "SSH not reachable or key rejected": provisioning not finished, wrong key,
  or wrong user. Test: ssh -i C:\Scripts\keys\<key> clouduser@<IP> hostname

- "Host key verification failed" after re-provisioning a node: delete
  C:\Scripts\k3s\known_hosts and re-run.

- "no passwordless sudo": give clouduser NOPASSWD sudo on that node.

- Node prep fails egress check: nodes need outbound HTTPS to get.k3s.io,
  update.k3s.io and github.com through the host NAT.

- Workers stuck NotReady: check the node firewall allows 192.168.100.0/24
  (k3s-node-prep.sh does this) and run journalctl -u k3s-agent -n 200.

- Start over on a node: sudo /usr/local/bin/k3s-uninstall.sh (server) or
  k3s-agent-uninstall.sh (agent) - /opt/bin on read-only images - then re-run
  Deploy-K3sCluster.ps1.

================================================================================
  End of instructions
================================================================================
variables.k3sDeployScriptContent:
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Deploys a K3s Kubernetes cluster across the Azure Local SFF nested VMs from
    the Hyper-V host, end to end, with one command.

.DESCRIPTION
    Runs on the Hyper-V host (Azure VM) after the nested VMs have been
    provisioned and Arc-enabled through the Azure portal. It:

      1. Discovers the nested VM IPs (Hyper-V MAC -> DHCP lease), or uses -NodeIPs
      2. Waits (with -Wait) until every node accepts SSH as clouduser with
         passwordless sudo, i.e. provisioning has finished
      3. Uploads the Linux scripts to /tmp/k3s-lab on every node over SSH
      4. Runs k3s-node-prep.sh on every node (kernel modules, sysctl, firewall, egress)
      5. Installs the first K3s server on the first node (NestedVM-01)
      6. Joins the remaining nodes, as agents (-Topology ServerAgents, default)
         or as additional embedded-etcd servers (-Topology HA)
      7. Waits for all nodes to be Ready and labels agent nodes as workers
      8. Saves a kubeconfig for the host to <OutputPath>\kubeconfig, and with
         -InstallKubectl downloads a matching kubectl.exe
      9. With -EnableArc, connects the cluster to Azure Arc via setup-k3s-arc.sh
         (service principal for unattended runs, device code otherwise)

    Every step is idempotent: re-running skips nodes that already run K3s.
    Secrets (cluster token, service principal secret) are sent to the nodes
    over SSH stdin into mode-600 files that are deleted afterwards, never on a
    command line.

.PARAMETER NodeIPs
    Node IPs in role order (first = initial server). When omitted, nodes are
    discovered from Hyper-V VMs named <NestedVmPrefix>-* and the DHCP scope.

.PARAMETER SshKeyPath
    Private key used for every node. When omitted, each node uses
    <SshKeyDirectory>\<VMName>.pem (or <IP>.pem), or the only key file in that
    directory.

.PARAMETER SshKeyDirectory
    Folder holding the provisioning key(s) downloaded from the Azure portal.
    Default C:\Scripts\keys.

.PARAMETER Topology
    ServerAgents (default): one server + agents, matching NestedVM-01 as the
    management node. HA: every node is a server with embedded etcd (needs an
    odd node count, so 3 for this lab).

.PARAMETER Wait
    Poll until nodes are discovered, keys are present and SSH works, up to
    -TimeoutMinutes. Start it right after provisioning and walk away.

.PARAMETER EnableArc
    Connect the cluster to Azure Arc after it is built. For unattended runs pass
    -ArcServicePrincipal (user name = appId, password = secret) and
    -ArcTenantId, or set AZURE_CLIENT_ID / AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET / AZURE_TENANT_ID
    in the environment. Otherwise a device code is shown in this console.

.EXAMPLE
    C:\Scripts\Deploy-K3sCluster.ps1 -Wait

    Waits for the three nodes and the key in C:\Scripts\keys, then builds a
    1 server + 2 agent cluster.

.EXAMPLE
    C:\Scripts\Deploy-K3sCluster.ps1 -Topology HA -InstallKubectl

    Builds a three-server HA cluster and installs kubectl on the host.

.EXAMPLE
    $sp = Get-Credential   # appId / client secret
    C:\Scripts\Deploy-K3sCluster.ps1 -EnableArc -ArcServicePrincipal $sp -ArcTenantId <tenant> `
        -ArcSubscriptionId <sub> -ArcResourceGroup rg-arc-k3s -ArcLocation uksouth

    Builds the cluster and connects it to Azure Arc unattended.

.NOTES
    Requires the OpenSSH client (built into Windows Server 2025; installed
    automatically if missing). Logs to <OutputPath>\deploy-k3s.log.
#>

#Requires -RunAsAdministrator

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string[]]$NodeIPs,
    [string]$NestedVmPrefix = "NestedVM",
    [string]$DhcpScopeId = "192.168.100.0",
    [string]$NodeCidr = "192.168.100.0/24",

    [string]$SshUser = "clouduser",
    [string]$SshKeyPath,
    [string]$SshKeyDirectory = "C:\Scripts\keys",

    [ValidateSet("ServerAgents", "HA")]
    [string]$Topology = "ServerAgents",
    [string]$K3sVersion,
    [string]$ClusterName = "sff-k3s",

    [string]$ScriptsPath = "C:\Scripts",
    [string]$OutputPath = "C:\Scripts\k3s",

    [switch]$Wait,
    [int]$PollIntervalSeconds = 60,
    [int]$TimeoutMinutes = 120,
    [int]$NodeReadyTimeoutMinutes = 15,

    [switch]$InstallKubectl,

    [switch]$EnableArc,
    [string]$ArcResourceGroup = "arc-k3s-rg",
    [string]$ArcClusterName = "arc-k3s-cluster",
    [string]$ArcLocation = "eastus",
    [System.Management.Automation.PSCredential]$ArcServicePrincipal,
    [string]$ArcTenantId,
    [string]$ArcSubscriptionId,
    [switch]$SkipAzureRbac
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$ScriptVersion = "1.0.0"
$RemoteDir = "/tmp/k3s-lab"
# Text piped to ssh.exe is base64 (see Send-RemoteText), so ASCII is all that is needed.
$OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII

if (-not (Test-Path $OutputPath)) {
    New-Item -Path $OutputPath -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
}
$LogFile = Join-Path $OutputPath "deploy-k3s.log"
$KnownHostsFile = Join-Path $OutputPath "known_hosts"
$KeyCacheDir = Join-Path $OutputPath "keys"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Logging
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Write-Status {
    param([string]$Message, [string]$Color = "White")
    $line = "{0} - [Deploy-K3sCluster.ps1 v{1}] {2}" -f (Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"), $ScriptVersion, $Message
    Write-Host $line -ForegroundColor $Color
    Add-Content -Path $LogFile -Value $line -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}

function Write-Step {
    param([string]$Message)
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Status "=== $Message ===" "Cyan"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# File ACL: OpenSSH refuses private keys readable by other users
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Set-OwnerOnlyAcl {
    param([string]$Path)
    $me = [System.Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent().Name
    $null = & icacls.exe $Path /inheritance:r /grant:r "${me}:(F)" "*S-1-5-18:(F)" "*S-1-5-32-544:(F)"
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "icacls failed to restrict permissions on $Path"
    }
}

# Writes UTF-8 (no BOM) text with LF line endings.
function Write-LfFile {
    param([string]$Path, [string]$Content)
    $normalized = $Content.Replace("`r`n", "`n")
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $normalized, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# OpenSSH client
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Resolve-SshExe {
    $cmd = Get-Command "ssh.exe" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($cmd -and $cmd.Path) { return $cmd.Path }
    $builtin = Join-Path $env:WINDIR "System32\OpenSSH\ssh.exe"
    if (Test-Path $builtin) { return $builtin }

    Write-Status "OpenSSH client not found - installing Windows capability OpenSSH.Client..." "Yellow"
    $cap = Get-WindowsCapability -Online -Name "OpenSSH.Client*" | Select-Object -First 1
    if (-not $cap) { throw "OpenSSH.Client capability is not available on this host." }
    Add-WindowsCapability -Online -Name $cap.Name | Out-Null
    if (Test-Path $builtin) { return $builtin }
    throw "OpenSSH client install did not produce $builtin"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Native command runner. Streams output to the console/log and returns it.
# Remote commands must not contain double quotes: Windows PowerShell 5.1 does
# not escape them when passing arguments to native executables.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Invoke-Native {
    param(
        [string]$FilePath,
        [string[]]$Arguments,
        [string]$InputText,
        [switch]$Quiet,
        [switch]$Interactive
    )

    $prevEap = $ErrorActionPreference
    $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
    try {
        if ($Interactive) {
            & $FilePath @Arguments
            return [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE; Output = ""; Lines = @() }
        }

        $handler = {
            $l = "$_"
            if (-not $Quiet) {
                Write-Host "    $l" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
                Add-Content -Path $LogFile -Value "    $l" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            }
            $l
        }
        if ($PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey("InputText")) {
            $lines = @($InputText | & $FilePath @Arguments 2>&1 | ForEach-Object $handler)
        } else {
            $lines = @(& $FilePath @Arguments 2>&1 | ForEach-Object $handler)
        }
        $code = $LASTEXITCODE
    } finally {
        $ErrorActionPreference = $prevEap
    }

    return [pscustomobject]@{ ExitCode = $code; Output = ($lines -join "`n").Trim(); Lines = $lines }
}

function Get-SshArgs {
    param($Node, [switch]$Tty, [switch]$NoStdin)
    $sshArgs = @(
        "-i", $Node.KeyPath,
        "-o", "BatchMode=yes",
        "-o", "StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new",
        "-o", "UserKnownHostsFile=$KnownHostsFile",
        "-o", "ConnectTimeout=15",
        "-o", "ServerAliveInterval=30",
        "-o", "LogLevel=ERROR"
    )
    if ($Tty) { $sshArgs += "-t" }
    if ($NoStdin) { $sshArgs += "-n" }
    $sshArgs += "$SshUser@$($Node.IP)"
    return $sshArgs
}

function Invoke-Remote {
    param(
        $Node,
        [string]$Command,
        [string]$InputText,
        [switch]$Quiet,
        [switch]$Interactive,
        [switch]$AllowFailure
    )
    $hasInput = $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey("InputText")
    $noStdin = -not $hasInput -and -not $Interactive
    $params = @{
        FilePath    = $script:SshExe
        Arguments   = @(Get-SshArgs -Node $Node -Tty:$Interactive -NoStdin:$noStdin) + @($Command)
        Quiet       = $Quiet
        Interactive = $Interactive
    }
    if ($hasInput) { $params.InputText = $InputText }
    $result = Invoke-Native @params
    if ($result.ExitCode -ne 0 -and -not $AllowFailure) {
        throw "Command failed on $($Node.Name) ($($Node.IP)) with exit code $($result.ExitCode): $Command"
    }
    return $result
}

# Upload text to a file under $RemoteDir via SSH stdin (no scp/sftp dependency).
# Content travels as base64 so encoding, BOMs and CRLF cannot corrupt it; the
# file is LF-only UTF-8, mode 600, in a mode-700 directory owned by the SSH user.
function Send-RemoteText {
    param($Node, [string]$Content, [string]$FileName)
    $normalized = $Content.TrimStart([char]0xFEFF).Replace("`r`n", "`n")
    $b64 = [Convert]::ToBase64String((New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false).GetBytes($normalized))
    # tr keeps only base64 characters, dropping any BOM/CRLF the console adds to stdin.
    $cmd = "umask 077; mkdir -p $RemoteDir; chmod 700 $RemoteDir; tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9+/=' | base64 -d > $RemoteDir/$FileName"
    $null = Invoke-Remote -Node $Node -Command $cmd -InputText $b64 -Quiet
}

# Runs a k3s subcommand as root. PATH covers /opt/bin, used on read-only images.
function Invoke-K3s {
    param($Node, [string]$Arguments, [switch]$Quiet, [switch]$AllowFailure)
    $cmd = "sudo /bin/sh -c 'PATH=`$PATH:/usr/local/bin:/opt/bin; k3s $Arguments'"
    return Invoke-Remote -Node $Node -Command $cmd -Quiet:$Quiet -AllowFailure:$AllowFailure
}

# Single-quote a value for a POSIX shell env file.
function ConvertTo-ShellLiteral {
    param([string]$Value)
    return "'" + $Value.Replace("'", "'\''") + "'"
}

function New-EnvFileContent {
    param([System.Collections.IDictionary]$Values)
    $lines = foreach ($k in $Values.Keys) {
        if ($null -ne $Values[$k] -and "$($Values[$k])" -ne "") {
            "{0}={1}" -f $k, (ConvertTo-ShellLiteral "$($Values[$k])")
        }
    }
    return (($lines -join "`n") + "`n")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Node discovery (same MAC -> DHCP lease approach as Get-SffNodeVoucher.ps1)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Normalize-MacAddress {
    param([string]$Mac)
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Mac)) { return "" }
    return (($Mac -replace "[-:\.]", "").ToUpperInvariant())
}

function Get-ClusterNodes {
    if ($NodeIPs) {
        return @($NodeIPs | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ Name = $_; IP = $_; KeyPath = $null; HostName = $null; NodeName = $null; Role = $null } })
    }

    $vms = @(Get-VM -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.Name -like "$NestedVmPrefix-*" } | Sort-Object Name)
    if ($vms.Count -eq 0) {
        throw "No Hyper-V VMs named '$NestedVmPrefix-*' found. Pass -NodeIPs explicitly."
    }
    $notRunning = @($vms | Where-Object { $_.State -ne "Running" })
    if ($notRunning.Count -gt 0) {
        throw "VM(s) not running: $(($notRunning | ForEach-Object { $_.Name }) -join ', ')"
    }

    $leases = @(Get-DhcpServerV4Lease -ScopeId $DhcpScopeId -ErrorAction Stop |
                Where-Object { $_.AddressState -like "*Active*" -and -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($_.ClientId) })

    $nodes = @()
    foreach ($vm in $vms) {
        $adapter = Get-VMNetworkAdapter -VMName $vm.Name | Select-Object -First 1
        $mac = Normalize-MacAddress $adapter.MacAddress
        $lease = $leases | Where-Object { (Normalize-MacAddress $_.ClientId) -eq $mac } | Select-Object -First 1
        if (-not $lease) {
            throw "No active DHCP lease in scope $DhcpScopeId for $($vm.Name) (MAC $mac)."
        }
        $nodes += [pscustomobject]@{
            Name     = $vm.Name
            IP       = $lease.IPAddress.IPAddressToString
            KeyPath  = $null
            HostName = $null
            NodeName = $null
            Role     = $null
        }
    }
    return $nodes
}

# Copies the portal-downloaded key to a private, LF-normalised cache file.
function Resolve-NodeKey {
    param($Node)
    $source = $null
    if ($SshKeyPath) {
        $source = $SshKeyPath
    } else {
        foreach ($candidate in @("$($Node.Name).pem", "$($Node.IP).pem", "$($Node.Name)", "$($Node.IP)")) {
            $p = Join-Path $SshKeyDirectory $candidate
            if (Test-Path $p -PathType Leaf) { $source = $p; break }
        }
        if (-not $source -and (Test-Path $SshKeyDirectory)) {
            $all = @(Get-ChildItem -Path $SshKeyDirectory -File | Where-Object { $_.Extension -ne ".pub" })
            if ($all.Count -eq 1) { $source = $all[0].FullName }
        }
    }
    if (-not $source -or -not (Test-Path $source -PathType Leaf)) {
        throw "No SSH key for $($Node.Name). Put the portal key in $SshKeyDirectory (as $($Node.Name).pem, or a single key for all nodes) or pass -SshKeyPath."
    }

    if (-not (Test-Path $KeyCacheDir)) {
        New-Item -Path $KeyCacheDir -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
    }
    $dest = Join-Path $KeyCacheDir ("{0}.key" -f ($Node.Name -replace "[^A-Za-z0-9\.-]", "_"))
    Write-LfFile -Path $dest -Content ([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($source))
    Set-OwnerOnlyAcl -Path $dest
    return $dest
}

# Returns $null when ready, otherwise a reason string.
function Test-NodeReady {
    param($Node)
    $r = Invoke-Remote -Node $Node -Command "hostname; sudo -n true && echo SUDO_OK" -Quiet -AllowFailure
    if ($r.ExitCode -eq 255) { return "SSH not reachable or key rejected: $($r.Output)" }
    if ($r.Output -notmatch "SUDO_OK") {
        throw "$($Node.Name): SSH works but '$SshUser' has no passwordless sudo. Grant NOPASSWD sudo and re-run."
    }
    $name = $r.Lines | Where-Object { $_ -and $_ -ne "SUDO_OK" } | Select-Object -First 1
    if (-not $name) { $name = $Node.Name }
    $Node.HostName = "$name".Trim().ToLowerInvariant()
    return $null
}

function Wait-ForNodes {
    $deadline = (Get-Date).AddMinutes($TimeoutMinutes)
    $attempt = 0
    while ($true) {
        $attempt++
        $problems = @()
        $nodes = $null
        try {
            $nodes = @(Get-ClusterNodes)
            foreach ($n in $nodes) {
                try {
                    $n.KeyPath = Resolve-NodeKey -Node $n
                    $reason = Test-NodeReady -Node $n
                    if ($reason) { $problems += "$($n.Name) ($($n.IP)): $reason" }
                } catch {
                    if ($_.Exception.Message -match "passwordless sudo") { throw }
                    $problems += "$($n.Name): $($_.Exception.Message)"
                }
            }
        } catch {
            if ($_.Exception.Message -match "passwordless sudo") { throw }
            $problems += $_.Exception.Message
        }

        if ($problems.Count -eq 0) { return $nodes }

        foreach ($p in $problems) { Write-Status $p "Yellow" }
        if (-not $Wait) {
            throw "Nodes are not ready. Fix the issues above or re-run with -Wait to poll until they are."
        }
        if ((Get-Date) -ge $deadline) {
            throw "Timed out after $TimeoutMinutes minutes waiting for nodes."
        }
        $remaining = [math]::Round(($deadline - (Get-Date)).TotalMinutes, 1)
        Write-Status "Attempt $attempt - not ready yet; retrying in ${PollIntervalSeconds}s (${remaining}m left)" "DarkGray"
        Start-Sleep -Seconds $PollIntervalSeconds
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Script staging
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Find-LocalScript {
    param([string[]]$Names)
    foreach ($dir in @($ScriptsPath, $PSScriptRoot)) {
        foreach ($name in $Names) {
            $p = Join-Path $dir $name
            if (Test-Path $p -PathType Leaf) { return $p }
        }
    }
    throw "Could not find $($Names -join ' / ') in $ScriptsPath or $PSScriptRoot."
}

function Get-StagedScripts {
    $map = [ordered]@{
        "k3s-node-prep.sh"      = @("k3s-node-prep.sh")
        "k3s-install-server.sh" = @("k3s-install-server.sh")
        "k3s-join-agent.sh"     = @("k3s-join-agent.sh")
    }
    if ($EnableArc) {
        # Blob name on the host is setup_k3s_arc.sh; repo name is setup-k3s-arc.sh.
        $map["setup-k3s-arc.sh"] = @("setup_k3s_arc.sh", "setup-k3s-arc.sh")
    }
    $result = [ordered]@{}
    foreach ($remoteName in $map.Keys) {
        $local = Find-LocalScript -Names $map[$remoteName]
        # Strip any UTF-8 BOM; Send-RemoteText normalises line endings.
        $result[$remoteName] = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($local).TrimStart([char]0xFEFF)
    }
    return $result
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cluster steps
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Get-ClusterNodeTable {
    param($Server)
    $r = Invoke-K3s -Node $Server -Arguments "kubectl get nodes -o wide --no-headers" -Quiet -AllowFailure
    $rows = @()
    if ($r.ExitCode -ne 0) { return $rows }
    foreach ($line in $r.Lines) {
        $cols = @($line -split "\s+" | Where-Object { $_ })
        if ($cols.Count -ge 6) {
            $rows += [pscustomobject]@{ Name = $cols[0]; Status = $cols[1]; Roles = $cols[2]; Version = $cols[4]; IP = $cols[5] }
        }
    }
    return $rows
}

function Wait-ClusterReady {
    param($Server, [int]$Expected)
    $deadline = (Get-Date).AddMinutes($NodeReadyTimeoutMinutes)
    while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline) {
        $rows = @(Get-ClusterNodeTable -Server $Server)
        $ready = @($rows | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq "Ready" })
        if ($ready.Count -ge $Expected) { return $rows }
        Write-Status "Nodes Ready: $($ready.Count)/$Expected - waiting..." "DarkGray"
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 10
    }
    throw "Timed out after $NodeReadyTimeoutMinutes minutes waiting for $Expected Ready nodes."
}

function Save-Kubeconfig {
    param($Server)
    $r = Invoke-Remote -Node $Server -Command "sudo cat /etc/rancher/k3s/k3s.yaml" -Quiet
    $yaml = ($r.Lines -join "`n")
    $yaml = $yaml.Replace("https://127.0.0.1:6443", "https://$($Server.IP):6443")
    $yaml = $yaml -replace "(?m)^(\s*(?:-\s+)?(?:name|cluster|user|current-context):\s+)default\s*$", "`${1}$ClusterName"
    $path = Join-Path $OutputPath "kubeconfig"
    Write-LfFile -Path $path -Content ($yaml + "`n")
    Set-OwnerOnlyAcl -Path $path
    return $path
}

function Install-HostKubectl {
    param([string]$KubernetesVersion)
    $binDir = Join-Path $OutputPath "bin"
    $exe = Join-Path $binDir "kubectl.exe"
    if (-not (Test-Path $binDir)) { New-Item -Path $binDir -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null }

    $url = "https://dl.k8s.io/release/$KubernetesVersion/bin/windows/amd64/kubectl.exe"
    Write-Status "Downloading kubectl $KubernetesVersion from $url"
    $ProgressPreference = "SilentlyContinue"
    [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12
    Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $exe -UseBasicParsing
    $expected = (Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$url.sha256" -UseBasicParsing).Content
    if ($expected -is [byte[]]) { $expected = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($expected) }
    $expected = $expected.Trim().Split(" ")[0]
    $actual = (Get-FileHash -Path $exe -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
    if ($actual -ne $expected.ToUpperInvariant()) {
        Remove-Item $exe -Force
        throw "kubectl.exe checksum mismatch (expected $expected, got $actual)."
    }
    Write-Status "kubectl installed at $exe (checksum verified)" "Green"
    return $exe
}

function Invoke-ArcOnboarding {
    param($Server, $OtherServers)

    $values = [ordered]@{
        RESOURCE_GROUP  = $ArcResourceGroup
        CLUSTER_NAME    = $ArcClusterName
        LOCATION        = $ArcLocation
        SKIP_AZURE_RBAC = $(if ($SkipAzureRbac) { "true" } else { "false" })
    }

    $clientId = $env:AZURE_CLIENT_ID
    $secret = $env:AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET
    $tenant = $env:AZURE_TENANT_ID
    $subscription = $env:AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID
    if ($ArcServicePrincipal) {
        $clientId = $ArcServicePrincipal.UserName
        $secret = $ArcServicePrincipal.GetNetworkCredential().Password
    }
    if ($ArcTenantId) { $tenant = $ArcTenantId }
    if ($ArcSubscriptionId) { $subscription = $ArcSubscriptionId }

    $unattended = $clientId -and $secret -and $tenant
    if ($unattended) {
        $values["AZURE_CLIENT_ID"] = $clientId
        $values["AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET"] = $secret
        $values["AZURE_TENANT_ID"] = $tenant
    }
    if ($subscription) { $values["AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID"] = $subscription }

    Send-RemoteText -Node $Server -FileName "arc.env" -Content (New-EnvFileContent $values)
    try {
        if ($unattended) {
            Write-Status "Connecting to Azure Arc with service principal $clientId..."
            $null = Invoke-Remote -Node $Server -Command "sudo bash $RemoteDir/setup-k3s-arc.sh"
        } else {
            Write-Status "No service principal supplied - setup-k3s-arc.sh will show a device code below. Sign in at https://microsoft.com/devicelogin." "Yellow"
            $null = Invoke-Remote -Node $Server -Command "sudo bash $RemoteDir/setup-k3s-arc.sh" -Interactive
        }
    } finally {
        $null = Invoke-Remote -Node $Server -Command "rm -f $RemoteDir/arc.env" -Quiet -AllowFailure
    }

    # Azure RBAC webhooks are kube-apiserver flags, so every server needs them.
    if (-not $SkipAzureRbac) {
        foreach ($s in $OtherServers) {
            Write-Status "Configuring Azure RBAC webhooks on additional server $($s.Name)..."
            Send-RemoteText -Node $s -FileName "arc.env" -Content (New-EnvFileContent ([ordered]@{ ARC_WEBHOOKS_ONLY = "true" }))
            try {
                $null = Invoke-Remote -Node $s -Command "sudo bash $RemoteDir/setup-k3s-arc.sh"
            } finally {
                $null = Invoke-Remote -Node $s -Command "rm -f $RemoteDir/arc.env" -Quiet -AllowFailure
            }
        }
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$nodes = @()
try {
    Write-Step "K3s cluster deployment started (topology: $Topology)"
    $script:SshExe = Resolve-SshExe
    Write-Status "Using OpenSSH client: $script:SshExe"

    $scripts = Get-StagedScripts

    Write-Step "Waiting for nodes (SSH as $SshUser with passwordless sudo)"
    $nodes = @(Wait-ForNodes)
    if ($Topology -eq "HA" -and ($nodes.Count -lt 3 -or $nodes.Count % 2 -eq 0)) {
        throw "Topology HA needs an odd number of nodes (3+); found $($nodes.Count). Use -Topology ServerAgents."
    }

    # Duplicate hostnames would make nodes collide in K3s; fall back to VM names.
    $dupes = @($nodes | Group-Object HostName | Where-Object { $_.Count -gt 1 })
    foreach ($n in $nodes) {
        if ($dupes.Count -gt 0) {
            $n.NodeName = ($n.Name.ToLowerInvariant() -replace "[^a-z0-9\-\.]", "-")
        } else {
            $n.NodeName = $n.HostName
        }
    }
    if ($dupes.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Status "Nodes share hostnames ($(($dupes | ForEach-Object { $_.Name }) -join ', ')); using VM names as K3s node names." "Yellow"
    }

    $server = $nodes[0]
    $server.Role = "server (init)"
    for ($i = 1; $i -lt $nodes.Count; $i++) {
        if ($Topology -eq "HA") { $nodes[$i].Role = "server" } else { $nodes[$i].Role = "agent" }
    }
    $nodes | Format-Table Name, IP, NodeName, Role -AutoSize | Out-String | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }

    $useNodeNameOverride = $dupes.Count -gt 0
    $serverIps = @($nodes | Where-Object { $_.Role -like "server*" } | ForEach-Object { $_.IP })

    Write-Step "Uploading scripts to $RemoteDir on each node"
    foreach ($n in $nodes) {
        foreach ($name in $scripts.Keys) {
            Send-RemoteText -Node $n -FileName $name -Content $scripts[$name]
        }
        Write-Status "$($n.Name): uploaded $($scripts.Keys -join ', ')" "Green"
    }

    Write-Step "Preparing nodes (k3s-node-prep.sh)"
    foreach ($n in $nodes) {
        Write-Status "Preparing $($n.Name) ($($n.IP))..."
        $null = Invoke-Remote -Node $n -Command "sudo env NODE_CIDR=$NodeCidr bash $RemoteDir/k3s-node-prep.sh"
    }

    Write-Step "Installing first K3s server on $($server.Name) ($($server.IP))"
    $envValues = [ordered]@{
        K3S_ROLE            = "init"
        CLUSTER_INIT        = $(if ($Topology -eq "HA") { "true" } else { "false" })
        NODE_IP             = $server.IP
        NODE_NAME           = $(if ($useNodeNameOverride) { $server.NodeName } else { "" })
        TLS_SANS            = ($serverIps -join " ")
        INSTALL_K3S_VERSION = $K3sVersion
    }
    Send-RemoteText -Node $server -FileName "k3s.env" -Content (New-EnvFileContent $envValues)
    try {
        $null = Invoke-Remote -Node $server -Command "sudo bash $RemoteDir/k3s-install-server.sh"
    } finally {
        $null = Invoke-Remote -Node $server -Command "rm -f $RemoteDir/k3s.env" -Quiet -AllowFailure
    }

    $token = (Invoke-Remote -Node $server -Command "sudo cat /var/lib/rancher/k3s/server/token" -Quiet).Output.Trim()
    if (-not $token) { throw "Could not read the cluster token from $($server.Name)." }
    $versionLine = (Invoke-K3s -Node $server -Arguments "--version" -Quiet).Lines | Select-Object -First 1
    $installedVersion = ($versionLine -split "\s+")[2]
    Write-Status "Server running K3s $installedVersion; other nodes will be pinned to it." "Green"

    $k3sUrl = "https://$($server.IP):6443"
    $others = @($nodes | Select-Object -Skip 1)
    foreach ($n in $others) {
        Write-Step "Joining $($n.Name) ($($n.IP)) as $($n.Role)"
        if ($n.Role -eq "server") {
            $envValues = [ordered]@{
                K3S_ROLE            = "join"
                K3S_URL             = $k3sUrl
                K3S_TOKEN           = $token
                NODE_IP             = $n.IP
                NODE_NAME           = $(if ($useNodeNameOverride) { $n.NodeName } else { "" })
                TLS_SANS            = ($serverIps -join " ")
                INSTALL_K3S_VERSION = $installedVersion
            }
            $joinScript = "k3s-install-server.sh"
        } else {
            $envValues = [ordered]@{
                K3S_URL             = $k3sUrl
                K3S_TOKEN           = $token
                NODE_IP             = $n.IP
                NODE_NAME           = $(if ($useNodeNameOverride) { $n.NodeName } else { "" })
                INSTALL_K3S_VERSION = $installedVersion
            }
            $joinScript = "k3s-join-agent.sh"
        }
        Send-RemoteText -Node $n -FileName "k3s.env" -Content (New-EnvFileContent $envValues)
        try {
            $null = Invoke-Remote -Node $n -Command "sudo bash $RemoteDir/$joinScript"
        } finally {
            $null = Invoke-Remote -Node $n -Command "rm -f $RemoteDir/k3s.env" -Quiet -AllowFailure
        }
    }
    $token = $null

    Write-Step "Waiting for $($nodes.Count) node(s) to be Ready"
    $rows = @(Wait-ClusterReady -Server $server -Expected $nodes.Count)
    foreach ($n in ($nodes | Where-Object { $_.Role -eq "agent" })) {
        $row = $rows | Where-Object { $_.IP -eq $n.IP } | Select-Object -First 1
        if ($row) {
            $null = Invoke-K3s -Node $server -Arguments "kubectl label node $($row.Name) node-role.kubernetes.io/worker=worker --overwrite" -Quiet
        }
    }
    $rows = @(Get-ClusterNodeTable -Server $server)
    $rows | Format-Table Name, Status, Roles, Version, IP -AutoSize | Out-String | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }

    Write-Step "Saving kubeconfig for the host"
    $kubeconfig = Save-Kubeconfig -Server $server
    Write-Status "Kubeconfig written to $kubeconfig (API: $k3sUrl)" "Green"

    $kubectl = $null
    if ($InstallKubectl) {
        $k8sVersion = ($installedVersion -split "\+")[0]
        $kubectl = Install-HostKubectl -KubernetesVersion $k8sVersion
        $check = Invoke-Native -FilePath $kubectl -Arguments @("--kubeconfig", $kubeconfig, "get", "nodes", "-o", "wide")
        if ($check.ExitCode -ne 0) {
            Write-Status "kubectl from the host could not reach $k3sUrl - check the node firewall." "Yellow"
        }
    }

    $state = [ordered]@{
        clusterName = $ClusterName
        topology    = $Topology
        k3sVersion  = $installedVersion
        apiServer   = $k3sUrl
        kubeconfig  = $kubeconfig
        deployedAt  = (Get-Date -Format "o")
        nodes       = @($nodes | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ vm = $_.Name; ip = $_.IP; nodeName = $_.NodeName; role = $_.Role } })
    }
    $state | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 | Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $OutputPath "cluster.json") -Encoding UTF8

    if ($EnableArc) {
        Write-Step "Connecting cluster to Azure Arc ($ArcResourceGroup/$ArcClusterName, $ArcLocation)"
        $otherServers = @($nodes | Where-Object { $_.Role -eq "server" })
        Invoke-ArcOnboarding -Server $server -OtherServers $otherServers
        Write-Status "Azure Arc onboarding complete." "Green"
    }

    Write-Host ""
    Write-Status "*** K3S CLUSTER READY: $($nodes.Count) node(s), $Topology, K3s $installedVersion ***" "Green"
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "Use the cluster from this host:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "  `$env:KUBECONFIG = '$kubeconfig'" -ForegroundColor White
    if ($kubectl) {
        Write-Host "  & '$kubectl' get nodes -o wide" -ForegroundColor White
    } else {
        Write-Host "  kubectl get nodes -o wide        (re-run with -InstallKubectl to get kubectl.exe)" -ForegroundColor White
    }
    Write-Host "Or on the server node:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host "  ssh -i $($server.KeyPath) $SshUser@$($server.IP) sudo k3s kubectl get nodes" -ForegroundColor White
    Write-Host "Log: $LogFile" -ForegroundColor Cyan
}
catch {
    Write-Status "ERROR: $($_.Exception.Message)" "Red"
    Write-Status "Stack trace: $($_.ScriptStackTrace)" "DarkGray"
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "Deployment failed - see $LogFile. The script is idempotent; fix the issue and re-run." -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 1
}
finally {
    # Best effort: make sure no secret-bearing env files are left on the nodes.
    if ($script:SshExe) {
        foreach ($n in $nodes) {
            if ($n.KeyPath) {
                $null = Invoke-Remote -Node $n -Command "rm -f $RemoteDir/k3s.env $RemoteDir/arc.env" -Quiet -AllowFailure
            }
        }
    }
}
variables.k3sNodePrepScriptContent:
#!/bin/bash
# Prepares an Azure Local SFF nested VM (NestedVM-0x) for K3s. Run with sudo on
# every node before installing the K3s server or agent. Safe to re-run.
#
# Called automatically by Deploy-K3sCluster.ps1 on the Hyper-V host; can also
# be run by hand:
#   sudo NODE_CIDR=192.168.100.0/24 bash ./k3s-node-prep.sh
#
# What it does:
#   1. Loads the overlay / br_netfilter kernel modules (persisted when /etc is writable)
#   2. Enables IPv4 forwarding and bridge netfilter sysctls (persisted when writable)
#   3. Opens the host firewall for cluster traffic (firewalld, or iptables when the
#      INPUT chain defaults to DROP/REJECT as on Azure Linux based images)
#   4. Verifies outbound HTTPS to the K3s download endpoints
#
# Optional environment:
#   NODE_CIDR         - node subnet allowed in by the firewall (default 192.168.100.0/24)
#   CLUSTER_CIDR      - K3s pod CIDR (default 10.42.0.0/16)
#   SERVICE_CIDR      - K3s service CIDR (default 10.43.0.0/16)
#   SKIP_EGRESS_CHECK - true to skip the outbound HTTPS check
#
set -euo pipefail

NODE_CIDR="${NODE_CIDR:-192.168.100.0/24}"
CLUSTER_CIDR="${CLUSTER_CIDR:-10.42.0.0/16}"
SERVICE_CIDR="${SERVICE_CIDR:-10.43.0.0/16}"
SKIP_EGRESS_CHECK="${SKIP_EGRESS_CHECK:-false}"

log()  { echo -e "\n\033[1;32m[INFO]\033[0m  $*"; }
warn() { echo -e "\n\033[1;33m[WARN]\033[0m  $*"; }
err()  { echo -e "\n\033[1;31m[ERROR]\033[0m $*" >&2; exit 1; }

check_root() {
  if [[ "${EUID:-0}" -ne 0 ]]; then
    err "Run as root (sudo bash $0)."
  fi
}

# Writes a file only when its directory is writable (parts of the SFF image are read-only).
write_if_possible() {
  local path="$1" content="$2"
  if mkdir -p "$(dirname "$path")" 2>/dev/null && printf '%s\n' "$content" >"$path" 2>/dev/null; then
    log "Persisted $path"
  else
    warn "Could not write $path (read-only filesystem?). Setting applies until next reboot only."
  fi
}

load_kernel_modules() {
  log "Step 1/4 - Loading kernel modules (overlay, br_netfilter)..."
  local m
  for m in overlay br_netfilter; do
    if modprobe "$m" 2>/dev/null; then
      log "Loaded $m"
    else
      warn "modprobe $m failed (may be built into the kernel)."
    fi
  done
  write_if_possible /etc/modules-load.d/k3s.conf "$(printf 'overlay\nbr_netfilter')"
}

configure_sysctl() {
  log "Step 2/4 - Configuring sysctl for Kubernetes networking..."
  local settings=(
    "net.ipv4.ip_forward=1"
    "net.bridge.bridge-nf-call-iptables=1"
    "net.bridge.bridge-nf-call-ip6tables=1"
  )
  local s
  for s in "${settings[@]}"; do
    sysctl -w "$s" >/dev/null 2>&1 || warn "sysctl -w $s failed"
  done
  write_if_possible /etc/sysctl.d/90-k3s.conf "$(printf '%s\n' "${settings[@]}")"
}

configure_firewall() {
  log "Step 3/4 - Opening host firewall for cluster traffic..."

  if command -v firewall-cmd &>/dev/null && systemctl is-active --quiet firewalld; then
    log "firewalld is active - adding trusted sources $NODE_CIDR $CLUSTER_CIDR $SERVICE_CIDR"
    local src
    for src in "$NODE_CIDR" "$CLUSTER_CIDR" "$SERVICE_CIDR"; do
      firewall-cmd --permanent --zone=trusted --add-source="$src" >/dev/null
    done
    firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=6443/tcp >/dev/null
    firewall-cmd --reload >/dev/null
    return
  fi

  if ! command -v iptables &>/dev/null; then
    log "No firewalld or iptables found - nothing to open."
    return
  fi

  # Azure Linux based images ship an iptables service whose INPUT policy is DROP
  # with only SSH allowed. That silently blocks 6443 (API), 10250 (kubelet),
  # 8472/udp (flannel VXLAN) and 2379-2380 (etcd), so allow the cluster ranges.
  local policy
  policy="$(iptables -S INPUT 2>/dev/null | awk '/^-P INPUT/ {print $3}')"
  if [[ "$policy" != "DROP" ]] && ! iptables -S INPUT 2>/dev/null | grep -q -- '-j REJECT'; then
    log "iptables INPUT policy is '${policy:-unknown}' with no REJECT rules - no changes needed."
    return
  fi

  log "iptables INPUT is restrictive (policy ${policy}) - inserting ACCEPT rules for cluster ranges."
  local src
  for src in "$NODE_CIDR" "$CLUSTER_CIDR" "$SERVICE_CIDR"; do
    iptables -C INPUT -s "$src" -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || iptables -I INPUT 1 -s "$src" -j ACCEPT
  done
  iptables -C INPUT -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || \
    iptables -I INPUT 1 -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
  iptables -C FORWARD -s "$CLUSTER_CIDR" -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || iptables -I FORWARD 1 -s "$CLUSTER_CIDR" -j ACCEPT
  iptables -C FORWARD -d "$CLUSTER_CIDR" -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || iptables -I FORWARD 1 -d "$CLUSTER_CIDR" -j ACCEPT

  # Persist before K3s adds its own chains so only the base rules are saved.
  local save_file=""
  for save_file in /etc/systemd/scripts/ip4save /etc/sysconfig/iptables; do
    if [[ -f "$save_file" ]]; then
      if iptables-save >"$save_file" 2>/dev/null; then
        log "Saved iptables rules to $save_file"
      else
        warn "Could not persist rules to $save_file; re-run this script after a reboot."
      fi
      return
    fi
  done
  warn "No known iptables save file found; rules apply until next reboot. Re-run this script after a reboot."
}

check_egress() {
  log "Step 4/4 - Checking outbound HTTPS to K3s download endpoints..."
  if [[ "$SKIP_EGRESS_CHECK" == "true" ]]; then
    warn "SKIP_EGRESS_CHECK=true - skipping."
    return
  fi
  command -v curl &>/dev/null || err "curl is required by the K3s installer but was not found."
  local url
  for url in https://get.k3s.io https://update.k3s.io/v1-release/channels https://github.com; do
    if curl -sS -o /dev/null --max-time 20 "$url"; then
      log "Reachable: $url"
    else
      err "Cannot reach $url. The node needs outbound HTTPS (via the host NAT) to install K3s."
    fi
  done
}

main() {
  echo "============================================================"
  echo "  K3s node preparation ($(hostname))"
  echo "============================================================"
  check_root
  load_kernel_modules
  configure_sysctl
  configure_firewall
  check_egress
  log "Node preparation complete."
}

variables.k3sInstallServerScriptContent:
#!/bin/bash
# Installs a K3s server on an Azure Local SFF nested VM. Run with sudo.
#
# Two modes (K3S_ROLE):
#   init - first server. Set CLUSTER_INIT=true to start embedded etcd so more
#          servers can join later (HA). Without it, a single server using SQLite.
#   join - additional server joining an HA cluster (needs K3S_URL + K3S_TOKEN).
#
# Called automatically by Deploy-K3sCluster.ps1 on the Hyper-V host; can also
# be run by hand:
#   sudo K3S_ROLE=init NODE_IP=192.168.100.100 TLS_SANS="192.168.100.100" bash ./k3s-install-server.sh
#
# Secrets (K3S_TOKEN) can be supplied in ENV_FILE instead of the environment so
# they never appear on a command line. The file is sourced when present.
#
# Optional environment:
#   ENV_FILE            - default /tmp/k3s-lab/k3s.env
#   K3S_ROLE            - init (default) | join
#   CLUSTER_INIT        - true to enable embedded etcd on the first server
#   K3S_URL             - https://<first-server>:6443 (join only)
#   K3S_TOKEN           - cluster token (required for join; optional for init)
#   NODE_IP             - IP to advertise (default: first 192.168.100.x address)
#   NODE_NAME           - override node name (default: hostname)
#   TLS_SANS            - space-separated extra API server certificate SANs
#   K3S_DISABLE         - space-separated packaged components to disable (default: traefik)
#   INSTALL_K3S_VERSION - pin version, e.g. v1.33.5+k3s1 (default: stable channel)
#   READY_TIMEOUT       - seconds to wait for the node to become Ready (default 300)
#
set -euo pipefail

# The K3s installer uses /opt/bin when /usr/local/bin is read-only; sudo may not have either on PATH.
export PATH="$PATH:/usr/local/bin:/opt/bin"

ENV_FILE="${ENV_FILE:-/tmp/k3s-lab/k3s.env}"
if [[ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]]; then
  # shellcheck disable=SC1090
  source "$ENV_FILE"
fi

K3S_ROLE="${K3S_ROLE:-init}"
CLUSTER_INIT="${CLUSTER_INIT:-false}"
K3S_DISABLE="${K3S_DISABLE:-traefik}"
TLS_SANS="${TLS_SANS:-}"
NODE_NAME="${NODE_NAME:-}"
READY_TIMEOUT="${READY_TIMEOUT:-300}"
CONFIG_FILE="/etc/rancher/k3s/config.yaml"

log()  { echo -e "\n\033[1;32m[INFO]\033[0m  $*"; }
warn() { echo -e "\n\033[1;33m[WARN]\033[0m  $*"; }
err()  { echo -e "\n\033[1;31m[ERROR]\033[0m $*" >&2; exit 1; }

check_root() {
  if [[ "${EUID:-0}" -ne 0 ]]; then
    err "Run as root (sudo bash $0)."
  fi
}

detect_node_ip() {
  if [[ -n "${NODE_IP:-}" ]]; then
    return
  fi
  NODE_IP="$(ip -4 addr show 2>/dev/null | grep -oE 'inet 192\.168\.100\.[0-9]+' | awk '{print $2}' | head -n1 || true)"
  if [[ -z "$NODE_IP" ]]; then
    NODE_IP="$(hostname -I 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' || true)"
  fi
  [[ -n "$NODE_IP" ]] || err "Could not determine this node's IP. Set NODE_IP."
}

write_config() {
  if [[ -f "$CONFIG_FILE" ]] && grep -q '^# Managed by k3s-install-server.sh' "$CONFIG_FILE"; then
    log "$CONFIG_FILE already written by this script - leaving it unchanged."
    return
  fi
  if [[ -f "$CONFIG_FILE" ]]; then
    cp "$CONFIG_FILE" "${CONFIG_FILE}.bak.$(date +%s)"
    warn "Existing $CONFIG_FILE backed up before rewrite."
  fi

  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$CONFIG_FILE")"
  {
    echo "# Managed by k3s-install-server.sh"
    echo "node-ip: \"${NODE_IP}\""
    echo "advertise-address: \"${NODE_IP}\""
    [[ -n "$NODE_NAME" ]] && echo "node-name: \"${NODE_NAME}\""
    echo "write-kubeconfig-mode: \"0600\""
    echo "tls-san:"
    echo "  - \"${NODE_IP}\""
    local san
    for san in $TLS_SANS; do
      [[ "$san" == "$NODE_IP" ]] || echo "  - \"${san}\""
    done
    if [[ -n "$K3S_DISABLE" ]]; then
      echo "disable:"
      local c
      for c in $K3S_DISABLE; do echo "  - \"${c}\""; done
    fi
    if [[ "$K3S_ROLE" == "init" && "$CLUSTER_INIT" == "true" ]]; then
      echo "cluster-init: true"
    fi
    if [[ "$K3S_ROLE" == "join" ]]; then
      echo "server: \"${K3S_URL}\""
    fi
  } >"$CONFIG_FILE"
  chmod 600 "$CONFIG_FILE"
  log "Wrote $CONFIG_FILE"
}

install_k3s() {
  if systemctl is-active --quiet k3s 2>/dev/null; then
    warn "K3s server is already running ($(k3s --version 2>/dev/null | head -n1)). Skipping install."
    return
  fi
  if systemctl is-active --quiet k3s-agent 2>/dev/null; then
    err "This node already runs k3s-agent. Uninstall it (k3s-agent-uninstall.sh) before making it a server."
  fi

  log "Installing K3s server (role: $K3S_ROLE, INSTALL_K3S_SKIP_SELINUX_RPM=true)..."
  # The SELinux RPM step fails on Azure Local SFF nodes, so it is always skipped.
  export INSTALL_K3S_SKIP_SELINUX_RPM=true
  export INSTALL_K3S_EXEC="server"
  if [[ -n "${INSTALL_K3S_VERSION:-}" ]]; then
    export INSTALL_K3S_VERSION
  else
    unset INSTALL_K3S_VERSION 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  if [[ -n "${K3S_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
    export K3S_TOKEN
  fi
  # K3S_URL would make the installer create an agent; the server URL lives in config.yaml.
  unset K3S_URL 2>/dev/null || true
  curl -sfL https://get.k3s.io | sh -s -
  log "K3s server installed."
}

wait_ready() {
  local name="${NODE_NAME:-$(hostname | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')}"
  log "Waiting up to ${READY_TIMEOUT}s for node '$name' to become Ready..."
  local deadline=$((SECONDS + READY_TIMEOUT))
  while (( SECONDS < deadline )); do
    if k3s kubectl get node "$name" --no-headers 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}' | grep -qx 'Ready'; then
      log "Node '$name' is Ready."
      return
    fi
    sleep 5
  done
  err "Timed out waiting for node '$name' to become Ready. Check: journalctl -u k3s -n 200"
}

main() {
  echo "============================================================"
  echo "  K3s server install ($(hostname), role: $K3S_ROLE)"
  echo "============================================================"
  check_root
  case "$K3S_ROLE" in
    init) ;;
    join)
      [[ -n "${K3S_URL:-}" ]]   || err "K3S_ROLE=join needs K3S_URL (https://<first-server>:6443)."
      [[ -n "${K3S_TOKEN:-}" ]] || err "K3S_ROLE=join needs K3S_TOKEN (from /var/lib/rancher/k3s/server/token)."
      ;;
    *) err "K3S_ROLE must be 'init' or 'join' (got '$K3S_ROLE')." ;;
  esac
  detect_node_ip
  if systemctl is-active --quiet k3s 2>/dev/null; then
    # Leave config.yaml alone: it may hold Arc RBAC kube-apiserver-arg entries.
    warn "K3s server is already running ($(k3s --version 2>/dev/null | head -n1)). Skipping config and install."
  else
    write_config
    install_k3s
  fi
  wait_ready
  log "K3s server ready on $NODE_IP. Version: $(k3s --version | head -n1)"
}

main "$@"
